records.literal_gloss: And said Samuel to Saul, me sent Yahweh to anoint you as king over his people, over Israel; and now listen to [the] voice of [the] words of Yahweh.

en.L: And Samuel said to Saul, "Me {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent to anoint you as king over {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, over Israel. And now, listen to the voice of the words of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Samuel said to Saul, "I am the one {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent to anoint you king over {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people Israel. So now, listen to what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is saying.
en.R: Samuel said to Saul, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} sent me to anoint you as king over {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people Israel. So now listen to the message from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y Samuel dijo a Saúl: «A mí me envió {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} para ungirte como rey sobre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, sobre Israel. Ahora, pues, escucha la voz de las palabras {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Samuel le dijo a Saúl: «Yo soy el que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} envió para ungirte rey sobre {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo Israel. Así que ahora escucha lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice.
es.R: Samuel le dijo a Saúl: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me envió a ungirte como rey de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo Israel. Así que ahora escucha el mensaje {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Samuel dit à Saül : « C’est moi que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a envoyé pour t’oindre comme roi sur {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, sur Israël. Et maintenant, écoute la voix des paroles {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Samuel dit à Saül : « C’est moi que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a envoyé pour t’oindre comme roi de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple Israël. Maintenant donc, écoute ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Samuel a dit à Saül : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a envoyé pour t’oindre comme roi de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple Israël. Alors maintenant, écoute le message {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na Samweli akamwambia Sauli, "Mimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinituma ili nikupake mafuta uwe mfalme juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, juu ya Israeli. Basi sasa isikilize sauti ya maneno ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Samweli akamwambia Sauli, "Mimi ndiye ambaye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinituma nikupake mafuta uwe mfalme juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Israeli. Basi sasa sikiliza yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anayosema.
sw.R: Samweli akamwambia Sauli, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinituma nikupake mafuta uwe mfalme juu ya watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Israeli. Basi sasa sikiliza ujumbe kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nói với Sau-lơ: "Chính tôi là người {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai đến xức dầu cho ông làm vua trên dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, trên Y-sơ-ra-ên. Vậy bây giờ, hãy nghe tiếng của những lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên nói với Sau-lơ: "Chính tôi là người {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai đến xức dầu cho ông làm vua trên dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vậy bây giờ, hãy lắng nghe lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên nói với Sau-lơ: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai tôi đến xức dầu cho ông làm vua trên dân Y-sơ-ra-ên của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Vậy bây giờ hãy nghe sứ điệp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 사무엘이 사울에게 말했다. "나를 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보내셔서 너에게 기름을 부어 그분의 백성 이스라엘 위에 왕으로 삼게 하셨다. 그러니 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀의 소리를 들어라.
ko.B: 사무엘이 사울에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 기름을 부어 그분의 백성 이스라엘의 왕으로 세우라고 보내신 사람이 바로 나다. 그러니 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀을 들어라.
ko.R: 사무엘이 사울에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 나를 보내셔서 너에게 기름을 부어 그분의 백성 이스라엘의 왕으로 세우게 하셨다. 그러니 이제 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 주시는 말씀을 들어라.

pt.L: E Samuel disse a Saul: "A mim {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} enviou para ungir você como rei sobre o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, sobre Israel. E agora, ouça a voz das palavras {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Samuel disse a Saul: "Fui eu que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} enviou para ungir você rei sobre o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, Israel. Portanto, ouça agora o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} está dizendo.
pt.R: Samuel disse a Saul: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} me enviou para ungir você como rei sobre o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo, Israel. Por isso, ouça agora a mensagem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: me the LORD sent: Samuel stresses that he is the one God sent
decisions.reason: The word "me" stands first in the sentence for emphasis. Samuel reminds Saul that it was through him that the LORD made Saul king (9:16; 10:1), so the command he is about to pass on carries the same authority as that anointing.

decisions.choice: listen to the voice of the words of the LORD: hear and do what he says
alternatives: obey the words of the LORD
decisions.reason: To "listen to the voice" of someone is to obey them. The phrase opens the question the whole chapter turns on: whether Saul will listen to the LORD (verses 19, 20, 22) or to the people (verse 24).

decisions.choice: I am the one the LORD sent (Balanced); listen to what the LORD is saying / the message from the LORD
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the stress on "me" (m1) with "I am the one"; Readable uses the plain order. Both levels give "the voice of the words" as what the LORD is saying, and keep "listen", since the chapter builds on that word (m2).

decisions.choice: Samuel and Saul still say "ông" and "tôi" to each other
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note; the prophet who anointed the king does not speak as his subject, and Saul does not speak to him as king.

source.text: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת פָּקַ֕דְתִּי אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֥ה עֲמָלֵ֖ק לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁר־שָׂ֥ם לוֹ֙ בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ בַּעֲלֹת֖וֹ מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh of hosts, I have taken note of what did Amalek to Israel, how he set against him on the way when he came up from Egypt.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts: I have taken note of what Amalek did to Israel, how he set [himself] against him on the way when he came up from Egypt.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says this: I have taken note of what Amalek did to Israel, how they opposed Israel on the road as Israel came up out of Egypt.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies says: I have not forgotten what the Amalekites did to Israel. They attacked the Israelites on the road when they were coming up out of Egypt.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos: He tomado en cuenta lo que hizo Amalec a Israel, cómo se le opuso en el camino cuando subía de Egipto.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos dice esto: He tomado en cuenta lo que Amalec le hizo a Israel, cómo se le enfrentó en el camino cuando Israel subía de Egipto.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos: No he olvidado lo que los amalecitas le hicieron a Israel. Atacaron a los israelitas en el camino cuando subían de Egipto.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : J’ai considéré ce qu’Amaleq a fait à Israël, comment il s’est opposé à lui sur le chemin, quand il montait d’Égypte.
fr.B: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : J’ai pris note de ce qu’Amaleq a fait à Israël, comment ils se sont dressés contre Israël sur la route, quand il montait d’Égypte.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées : Je n’ai pas oublié ce que les Amalécites ont fait à Israël. Ils ont attaqué les Israélites sur la route, quand ils sortaient d’Égypte.

sw.L: Hivi ndivyo asemavyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi: Nimeyaangalia yale Amaleki aliyowatendea Israeli, jinsi alivyojipanga dhidi yao njiani walipopanda kutoka Misri.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi asema hivi: Nimeyaangalia yale Amaleki aliyowatendea Israeli, jinsi walivyowapinga Israeli njiani walipopanda kutoka Misri.
sw.R: Hiki ndicho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi anachosema: Sijasahau yale Waamaleki waliyowatendea Israeli. Waliwashambulia Waisraeli njiani walipokuwa wakipanda kutoka Misri.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Ta đã ghi nhớ điều A-ma-léc đã làm cho Y-sơ-ra-ên, thể nào nó đã chống lại họ trên đường khi họ đi lên từ Ai Cập.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán thế này: Ta đã ghi nhớ điều A-ma-léc đã làm cho Y-sơ-ra-ên, thể nào chúng đã chặn đường Y-sơ-ra-ên khi Y-sơ-ra-ên từ Ai Cập đi lên.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân phán: Ta không quên điều người A-ma-léc đã làm cho Y-sơ-ra-ên. Chúng đã tấn công dân Y-sơ-ra-ên trên đường khi họ từ Ai Cập đi lên.

ko.L: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 아말렉이 이스라엘에게 한 일, 곧 이스라엘이 이집트에서 올라올 때 길에서 그를 대적한 일을 내가 눈여겨보았다.
ko.B: 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 아말렉이 이스라엘에게 한 일, 곧 이스라엘이 이집트에서 올라올 때 길에서 그들을 가로막은 일을 내가 눈여겨보았다.
ko.R: 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 아말렉 사람들이 이스라엘에게 한 일을 나는 잊지 않았다. 이스라엘 사람들이 이집트에서 올라올 때 아말렉 사람들이 길에서 그들을 공격했다.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Eu tomei nota do que Amaleque fez a Israel, como se pôs contra ele no caminho, quando ele subia do Egito.
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Eu tomei nota do que Amaleque fez a Israel, de como eles se opuseram a Israel no caminho, quando Israel subia do Egito.
pt.R: É isto o que diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos: Eu não esqueci o que os amalequitas fizeram a Israel. Eles atacaram os israelitas no caminho, quando eles estavam subindo do Egito.

decisions.choice: I have taken note of: I have marked it and will call it to account
decisions.reason: The verb means to pay attention to, to visit. Used of a wrong that was done, it means to hold someone to account for it (Exodus 20:5; 32:34). The LORD has not forgotten, and the command that follows carries out his sentence.

decisions.choice: what Amalek did: the attack on Israel in the wilderness
alternatives: how he laid an ambush for him on the way
decisions.reason: Amalek attacked Israel at Rephidim soon after the exodus (Exodus 17:8-16), striking the weary people at the rear (Deuteronomy 25:17-19). The LORD swore to blot out the memory of Amalek, and Deuteronomy charged Israel to do it once the people had rest in the land. Saul is now sent to carry out that old sentence.

decisions.choice: the LORD of hosts: the LORD who commands the armies of heaven and earth
decisions.reason: "Hosts" means armies. The title, first used in this book at 1:3, presents the LORD as the commander of every power. It fits a word that sends Israel to war at his order.

decisions.choice: the LORD of Armies; The LORD of Armies says this (Balanced); This is what the LORD of Armies says (Readable)
decisions.reason: As across Samuel and Kings, Literal keeps "the LORD of hosts" and Balanced and Readable say "Armies", the plain sense of "hosts" (m3). The messenger formula follows the same book-wide wording at each level.

decisions.choice: they, Israel (Balanced); I have not forgotten, the Amalekites (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of each nation as "he". Balanced and Readable use plural forms and name Israel where "him" would be unclear. Readable says "I have not forgotten" for "I have taken note" (m1), and "attacked" for "set against", as the events of Exodus 17:8 were.

decisions.choice: Amaleki (L, B); Waamaleki (R)
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the people named as one man, "Amaleki", as the Hebrew and the English do; Readable says "Waamaleki", the Amalekites, as the English Readable does. "BWANA wa majeshi" at every level, as in 1:3.

source.text: עַתָּה֩ לֵ֨ךְ וְהִכִּֽיתָ֜ה אֶת־עֲמָלֵ֗ק וְהַֽחֲרַמְתֶּם֙ אֶת־כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־ל֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א תַחְמֹ֖ל עָלָ֑יו וְהֵמַתָּ֞ה מֵאִ֣ישׁ עַד־אִשָּׁ֗ה מֵֽעֹלֵל֙ וְעַד־יוֹנֵ֔ק מִשּׁ֣וֹר וְעַד־שֶׂ֔ה מִגָּמָ֖ל וְעַד־חֲמֽוֹר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Now go and strike Amalek, and devote to destruction all that [is] to him, and not spare him; and put to death from man to woman, from child and to nursing [one], from ox and to sheep, from camel and to donkey.

en.L: Now go and strike Amalek, and devote to destruction all that he has, and do not spare him. And put [them] to death, from man to woman, from child to nursing infant, from ox to sheep, from camel to donkey."
en.B: Now go and strike Amalek. Devote to destruction everything they have, and do not spare them. Put them to death, men and women, children and nursing infants, cattle and sheep, camels and donkeys."
en.R: Now go and attack the Amalekites. Destroy them completely, with everything they have, as given over to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Do not spare them. Kill men and women, children and babies, cattle and sheep, camels and donkeys."

es.L: Ahora ve y hiere a Amalec, y {{plural_you:consagren|consagrad}} a la destrucción todo lo que tiene, y no lo perdones. Y da muerte desde el hombre hasta la mujer, desde el niño hasta el que mama, desde el buey hasta la oveja, desde el camello hasta el asno».
es.B: Ahora ve y ataca a Amalec. {{plural_you:Consagren|Consagrad}} a la destrucción todo lo que tienen, y no les perdones la vida. Mata a hombres y mujeres, niños y bebés de pecho, vacas y ovejas, camellos y asnos».
es.R: Ahora ve y ataca a los amalecitas. {{plural_you:Destrúyanlos|Destruidlos}} por completo, con todo lo que tienen, como pueblo entregado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. No les perdones la vida. Mata a hombres y mujeres, a niños y bebés, a vacas y ovejas, a camellos y burros».

fr.L: Maintenant, va et frappe Amaleq, et vouez à l’interdit tout ce qui est à lui, et ne l’épargne pas ; et fais mourir homme et femme, enfant et nourrisson, bœuf et mouton, chameau et âne. »
fr.B: Maintenant, va frapper Amaleq. Vouez à l’interdit tout ce qui lui appartient, et ne l’épargne pas. Fais mourir hommes et femmes, enfants et nourrissons, bœufs et moutons, chameaux et ânes. »
fr.R: Maintenant, va attaquer les Amalécites. Détruisez-les complètement, avec tout ce qu’ils possèdent, comme une chose donnée {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Ne les épargne pas. Tue les hommes et les femmes, les enfants et les bébés, les bœufs et les moutons, les chameaux et les ânes. »

sw.L: Sasa nenda ukampige Amaleki, na kuweka wakfu kwa maangamizi vyote alivyo navyo, wala usimhurumie. Bali uwaue, tangu mwanamume hadi mwanamke, tangu mtoto hadi anayenyonya, tangu ng'ombe hadi kondoo, tangu ngamia hadi punda."
sw.B: Sasa nenda ukawapige Waamaleki. Viweke wakfu kwa maangamizi vyote walivyo navyo, wala usiwahurumie. Waue wanaume na wanawake, watoto na wachanga wanaonyonya, ng'ombe na kondoo, ngamia na punda."
sw.R: Sasa nenda ukawashambulie Waamaleki. Waangamize kabisa pamoja na vyote walivyo navyo, kama vitu vilivyotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Usiwahurumie. Ua wanaume na wanawake, watoto na wachanga, ng'ombe na kondoo, ngamia na punda."

vi.L: Bây giờ hãy đi đánh A-ma-léc, và tận hiến cho sự hủy diệt mọi thứ nó có, đừng tha nó; hãy giết từ đàn ông đến đàn bà, từ trẻ con đến trẻ đang bú, từ bò đến chiên, từ lạc đà đến lừa."
vi.B: Bây giờ hãy đi đánh A-ma-léc. Hãy tận diệt mọi thứ chúng có, đừng tha chúng. Hãy giết cả đàn ông lẫn đàn bà, trẻ con lẫn trẻ đang bú, bò lẫn chiên, lạc đà lẫn lừa."
vi.R: Bây giờ hãy đi tấn công người A-ma-léc. Hãy tiêu diệt hoàn toàn chúng cùng mọi thứ chúng có, như vật đã dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Đừng tha chúng. Hãy giết đàn ông và đàn bà, trẻ con và trẻ sơ sinh, bò và chiên, lạc đà và lừa."

ko.L: 이제 가서 아말렉을 쳐라. 그리고 그에게 속한 모든 것을 진멸하고 그를 아끼지 마라. 남자부터 여자까지, 아이부터 젖먹이까지, 소부터 양까지, 낙타부터 나귀까지 죽여라."
ko.B: 이제 가서 아말렉을 쳐라. 그들에게 속한 모든 것을 진멸하고 그들을 아끼지 마라. 남자와 여자, 아이와 젖먹이, 소와 양, 낙타와 나귀를 다 죽여라."
ko.R: 이제 가서 아말렉 사람들을 공격하여라. 그들과 그들이 가진 모든 것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바친 것으로 여겨 완전히 없애라. 그들을 아끼지 마라. 남자와 여자, 아이와 젖먹이, 소와 양, 낙타와 나귀를 다 죽여라."

pt.L: Agora vai, e fere Amaleque, e consagrem à destruição tudo o que ele tem, e não o poupes; e mata desde o homem até a mulher, desde a criança até o bebê de peito, desde o boi até a ovelha, desde o camelo até o jumento."
pt.B: Agora vai e ataca Amaleque. Consagrem à destruição tudo o que eles têm, e não os poupes. Mata homens e mulheres, crianças e bebês de peito, bois e ovelhas, camelos e jumentos."
pt.R: Agora vai e ataca os amalequitas. Destruam completamente tudo o que eles têm, como coisa entregue {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Não os poupes. Mata homens e mulheres, crianças e bebês, bois e ovelhas, camelos e jumentos."

decisions.choice: devote to destruction: give over wholly to the LORD by destroying
decisions.reason: This is the verb behind the "devoted thing" of Leviticus 27:28-29, explained at Deuteronomy 7:2: what is devoted is taken out of human use and handed over to the LORD for good. In war it means the enemy is destroyed and nothing is kept for private gain (Joshua 6:17-19). The same word runs through this chapter (verses 8, 9, 15, 18, 20, 21), and the story turns on what Saul kept back.

decisions.choice: the ban on Amalek: the LORD's sentence on Amalek's attack, carried out by Israel
decisions.reason: This is one of the hardest commands in Scripture. The note at Deuteronomy 7:2 sets out what the Law itself says about such commands. Here the reason given is not the land or its worship but what Amalek had done: they had attacked Israel on the way out of Egypt, preying on the weak and weary (verse 2; Exodus 17:8-16; Deuteronomy 25:17-19), and the LORD had sworn to bring their memory to an end. Verse 18 calls them "the sinners". The command is the LORD's, not Saul's: it was not to be used for gain, and the chapter faults Saul for keeping the best for himself and his people (verses 9, 19). The text states the command as it was given. Amalekites still appear later in the book (27:8; 30:1), so the verse does not by itself settle how fully it was carried out or how its language of war is to be weighed.

decisions.choice: you (one person) ... you (many): Saul and his army
decisions.reason: Most of the verbs speak to Saul alone, but "devote to destruction" is plural. The command is given to Saul as king, and it binds the army that carries it out with him, which is why the people share the blame in verses 9, 15 and 21.

decisions.choice: from man to woman ... from camel to donkey: every person and every animal
decisions.reason: Pairs joined by "from ... to" name the two ends of a range to mean everything in it. Nothing living was to be kept, which rules out taking the herds as plunder (compare verse 9).

decisions.choice: destroy them completely, as given over to the LORD
decisions.reason: As at Deuteronomy 7:2, Readable gives the sense of the term in plain words: the Amalekites were to be destroyed because they were given over to the LORD, not taken for gain. Literal and Balanced keep "devote to destruction".

decisions.choice: they, them
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks of Amalek as "him", one nation. Literal keeps it; Balanced and Readable use the plural, since the command concerns a whole people.

decisions.choice: "vouer à l’interdit" (Literal, Balanced); "détruire complètement ... comme une chose donnée au SEIGNEUR" (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb means to give something over wholly to the LORD by destroying it (m1). French "vouer à l’interdit" is the established term for this, which Readable explains as the English does; "exterminer" would lose the sense of a thing given to God.

decisions.choice: "va", "frappe", "épargne", "fais mourir" (singular) and "vouez", "détruisez" (plural)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks to Saul and then to Saul with his army (m3); French has the same two forms and keeps the change, which the English cannot show.

decisions.choice: "consagrar a la destrucción" (L, B); "destruir por completo ... como entregado al SEÑOR" (R)
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as the Spanish of Deuteronomy 7:2: the ban (m1, m2) keeps its sense of giving something wholly over to the LORD at Literal and Balanced; Readable says it in plain words, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: singular "ve", "hiere", "perdones", "mata"; plural "{{plural_you:consagren|consagrad}}"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew speaks to Saul in the singular but makes the verb "devote to destruction" plural, Saul with his army (m3). Spanish keeps both numbers, the plural under the plural-you setting.

decisions.choice: kuweka wakfu kwa maangamizi (L, B); waangamize kabisa ... kama vitu vilivyotolewa kwa BWANA (R)
decisions.reason: The ban (*ḥerem*) gives something wholly to the LORD by destroying it (m1); Swahili joins "wakfu" (dedicated to God) with "maangamizi" (destruction) to keep both sides, and Readable spells it out, as the English Readable does. This wording is kept through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "tận hiến cho sự hủy diệt" (L); "tận diệt" (B); "tiêu diệt hoàn toàn, như vật đã dâng cho CHÚA" (R) for *ḥerem*
decisions.reason: To give over wholly to the LORD by destroying (meaning decision): Literal keeps both halves, Balanced uses the one Vietnamese word for total destruction, and Readable explains as the English does. Kept through the chapter.

decisions.choice: "진멸하다" (L, B); "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바친 것으로 여겨 완전히 없애다" (R)
decisions.reason: The ban gives a thing wholly to the LORD by destroying it (m1); "진멸하다" is the established word for it, and Readable says what it means, as the English Readable does. Used for the whole block.

decisions.choice: vai, fere, não o poupes, mata (tu); consagrem (vocês)
decisions.reason: The LORD's own words, which Samuel passes on, speak to Saul with "tu", as God addresses one person throughout the Portuguese Old Testament; Samuel's own words around them say "você" (13:11). The one plural verb, "devote to destruction", is "consagrem", to Saul and his army (m3).

decisions.choice: consagrar à destruição (L, B); destruir completamente, como coisa entregue ao SENHOR (R)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording of Deuteronomy 7:2 and Joshua 6 in Portuguese for the ban (m1), used again in verses 8-9, 15, 18, 20 and 21; Readable explains it, as the English Readable does.

source.text: וַיְשַׁמַּ֤ע שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת־הָעָ֔ם וַֽיִּפְקְדֵם֙ בַּטְּלָאִ֔ים מָאתַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף רַגְלִ֑י וַעֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים אֶת־אִ֥ישׁ יְהוּדָֽה׃

en.R: So Saul called the army together at Telaim and counted them. There were 200,000 soldiers on foot, and 10,000 men from Judah.

fr.B: Saül convoqua donc l’armée et la passa en revue à Telaïm : deux cent mille fantassins et dix mille hommes de Juda.

sw.B: Basi Sauli akaliita jeshi akalihesabu huko Telaimu: askari wa miguu laki mbili, na watu elfu kumi wa Yuda.
sw.R: Basi Sauli akaliita jeshi likusanyike Telaimu akalihesabu. Palikuwa na askari wa miguu laki mbili, na watu elfu kumi kutoka Yuda.

vi.L: Sau-lơ triệu tập dân chúng và kiểm điểm họ tại Tê-la-im: hai trăm nghìn bộ binh và mười nghìn người Giu-đa.

vi.R: Vậy Sau-lơ tập họp quân đội tại Tê-la-im và kiểm điểm họ. Có hai trăm nghìn bộ binh và mười nghìn người Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 사울이 백성을 불러 모아 들라임에서 그들을 점검하니, 보병이 200,000명이요, 유다 사람이 10,000명이었다.
ko.B: 그래서 사울은 군대를 불러 모아 들라임에서 점검했다. 보병이 200,000명이었고, 유다 사람이 10,000명이었다.
ko.R: 그래서 사울은 군대를 들라임에 불러 모아 수를 세었다. 걸어서 싸우는 군인이 200,000명이었고, 유다에서 온 사람이 10,000명이었다.

pt.L: E Saul convocou o povo e os passou em revista em Telaim: duzentos mil soldados a pé e dez mil homens de Judá.
pt.B: Então Saul convocou o exército e o passou em revista em Telaim: duzentos mil soldados de infantaria e dez mil homens de Judá.
pt.R: Então Saul reuniu o exército em Telaim e contou os soldados. Eram duzentos mil soldados a pé e dez mil homens de Judá.

decisions.choice: the people: the fighting men called up for war
decisions.reason: "The people" often means the army gathered for battle (11:11; 14:17). In this chapter "the people" are Saul's troops (verses 9, 15, 21, 24).

decisions.choice: Telaim: a place in the south of Judah
decisions.reason: The place is named only here. It is probably the Telem of Joshua 15:24, a town in the Negev of Judah, near the lands where Amalek roamed.

decisions.choice: and 10,000 men of Judah: Judah counted on its own
decisions.reason: As in 11:8, the men of Judah are counted apart from the rest of Israel. On the size of numbers counted in "thousands", see the note at Numbers 1:21.

decisions.choice: called up the army (Balanced); called the army together (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "summoned the people"; Balanced and Readable say what "the people" are here (m1).

en.B: Saul advanced to the city of Amalek and lay in ambush in the ravine.
en.R: Saul went to the town of the Amalekites. He hid his men in a dry riverbed, ready to attack.

fr.B: Saül s’avança jusqu’à la ville d’Amaleq et tendit une embuscade dans le ravin.

vi.B: Sau-lơ tiến đến thành A-ma-léc và mai phục trong khe suối.
vi.R: Sau-lơ đi đến thành của người A-ma-léc. Ông cho quân lính ẩn nấp trong một lòng suối cạn, sẵn sàng tấn công.

ko.B: 사울은 아말렉 성읍으로 나아가 골짜기에 군사를 매복시켰다.

pt.L: E Saul chegou até a cidade de Amaleque e pôs uma emboscada no vale.
pt.B: Saul avançou até a cidade de Amaleque e armou uma emboscada no ribeiro seco.
pt.R: Saul foi até a cidade dos amalequitas. Ele escondeu os seus homens no leito seco de um rio, prontos para atacar.

decisions.choice: lay in wait: set an ambush
decisions.reason: The vowels of the written form would suit a verb meaning "strove" or "fought", but the word is generally read as a form of the verb "lie in wait", which fits the place named: Saul hid his men in the valley before the attack.

decisions.choice: the wadi: a stream bed, dry except in the rainy season
decisions.reason: Such valleys cut deep through the dry south and gave cover for an army waiting to strike.

decisions.choice: the city of Amalek: an Amalekite settlement, not named
decisions.reason: The Amalekites were mostly herders who moved from place to place, but they also had settlements. This one is not named.

decisions.choice: He hid his men in a dry riverbed, ready to attack.
decisions.reason: Readable explains what an ambush is and what a wadi is (m1, m2).

records.literal_gloss: And said Saul to the Kenites, go, turn aside, go down from among [the] Amalekites, lest I sweep you away with him; and you showed steadfast love to all [the] sons of Israel when they came up from Egypt. And turned aside [the] Kenites from among Amalek.

en.L: And Saul said to the Kenites, "Go, turn aside, go down from among the Amalekites, lest I sweep you away with them. For you showed steadfast love to all the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel when they came up from Egypt." And the Kenites turned aside from among Amalek.
en.B: Saul said to the Kenites, "Go, leave, get away from the Amalekites, or I will sweep you away along with them. For you showed faithful love to all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} when they came up out of Egypt." So the Kenites moved away from the Amalekites.
en.R: Saul said to the Kenites, "Leave the Amalekites and go away from them. If you do not, I will destroy you along with them. You showed faithful love to all the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} when they came up out of Egypt." So the Kenites left the Amalekites.

es.L: Y Saúl dijo a los ceneos: «{{plural_you:Váyanse|Idos}}, {{plural_you:apártense|apartaos}}, {{plural_you:bajen|bajad}} de en medio de los amalecitas, no sea que {{plural_you:los|os}} destruya con ellos. Porque {{plural_you:ustedes mostraron|vosotros mostrasteis}} amor leal a todos los hijos de Israel cuando subieron de Egipto». Y los ceneos se apartaron de en medio de Amalec.
es.B: Saúl les dijo a los ceneos: «{{plural_you:Váyanse|Idos}}, {{plural_you:apártense|apartaos}}, {{plural_you:aléjense|alejaos}} de los amalecitas, o {{plural_you:los|os}} barreré junto con ellos. es.R: Saúl les dijo a los ceneos: «{{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} a los amalecitas y {{plural_you:aléjense|alejaos}} de ellos. Si no, {{plural_you:los|os}} destruiré junto con ellos. {{plural_you:Ustedes mostraron|Vosotros mostrasteis}} amor fiel a todos los israelitas cuando subieron de Egipto». Así que los ceneos se apartaron de los amalecitas.

fr.L: Et Saül dit aux Kéniens : « Allez, retirez-vous, descendez du milieu des Amalécites, de peur que je ne vous emporte avec eux. Car vous avez agi avec amour loyal envers tous les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël quand ils montaient d’Égypte. » Et les Kéniens se retirèrent du milieu d’Amaleq.
fr.B: Saül dit aux Kéniens : « Partez, éloignez-vous, quittez les Amalécites, sinon je vous anéantirai avec eux. Car vous avez montré un amour fidèle à tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} quand ils sont montés d’Égypte. » Les Kéniens s’éloignèrent donc des Amalécites.
fr.R: Saül a dit aux Kéniens : « Quittez les Amalécites et éloignez-vous d’eux. Sinon, je vous détruirai avec eux. Vous avez montré un amour fidèle à tous les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} quand ils sont sortis d’Égypte. » Alors les Kéniens ont quitté les Amalécites.

sw.L: Na Sauli akawaambia Wakeni, "Nendeni, ondokeni, shukeni kutoka katikati ya Waamaleki, nisije nikawafagilia mbali pamoja nao. Kwa maana ninyi mliwatendea wana wote wa Israeli upendo usiokoma walipopanda kutoka Misri." Basi Wakeni wakaondoka kutoka katikati ya Amaleki.
sw.B: Sauli akawaambia Wakeni, "Nendeni, ondokeni, jitengeni na Waamaleki, la sivyo nitawafagilia mbali pamoja nao. Kwa maana ninyi mliwatendea Waisraeli wote fadhili walipopanda kutoka Misri." Basi Wakeni wakaondoka kutoka kati ya Waamaleki.
sw.R: Sauli akawaambia Wakeni, "Waacheni Waamaleki mwende mbali nao. Msipofanya hivyo, nitawaangamiza pamoja nao. Ninyi mliwatendea Waisraeli wote fadhili walipopanda kutoka Misri." Basi Wakeni wakawaacha Waamaleki.

vi.L: Sau-lơ nói với người Kê-nít: "Hãy đi, hãy rút lui, hãy rời khỏi giữa người A-ma-léc, kẻo ta tiêu diệt các ngươi cùng với chúng. Vì các ngươi đã tỏ tình yêu thương thành tín với hết thảy con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên khi họ từ Ai Cập đi lên." Vậy người Kê-nít rút lui khỏi giữa A-ma-léc.
vi.B: Sau-lơ nói với người Kê-nít: "Hãy đi đi, hãy rời khỏi người A-ma-léc, kẻo ta tiêu diệt các ngươi cùng với chúng. Vì các ngươi đã tỏ lòng nhân từ với toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên khi họ từ Ai Cập đi lên." Vậy người Kê-nít rời khỏi người A-ma-léc.
vi.R: Sau-lơ nói với người Kê-nít: "Hãy rời khỏi người A-ma-léc và đi xa khỏi chúng. Nếu không, ta sẽ tiêu diệt các ngươi cùng với chúng. Các ngươi đã tỏ lòng nhân từ với toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên khi họ từ Ai Cập đi lên." Vậy người Kê-nít rời khỏi người A-ma-léc.

ko.L: 그리고 사울이 겐 사람들에게 말했다. "가거라, 떠나거라, 아말렉 사람들 가운데서 내려가거라. 내가 너희를 그들과 함께 쓸어버리지 않도록 하여라. 너희는 이스라엘 모든 자손이 이집트에서 올라올 때 그들에게 한결같은 사랑을 베풀었다." 그래서 겐 사람들이 아말렉 가운데서 떠났다.
ko.B: 사울이 겐 사람들에게 말했다. "어서 아말렉 사람들 가운데서 떠나 내려가거라. 그렇지 않으면 내가 너희도 그들과 함께 쓸어버릴 것이다. 너희는 이스라엘 모든 자손이 이집트에서 올라올 때 그들에게 한결같은 사랑을 베풀었다." 그래서 겐 사람들은 아말렉 사람들에게서 떠나갔다.
ko.R: 사울이 겐 사람들에게 말했다. "아말렉 사람들을 떠나 멀리 가거라. 그렇지 않으면 내가 너희도 그들과 함께 없앨 것이다. 너희는 이스라엘 모든 자손이 이집트에서 올라올 때 그들에게 변함없는 사랑을 베풀었다." 그래서 겐 사람들은 아말렉 사람들을 떠났다.

pt.L: E Saul disse aos queneus: "Vão, retirem-se, desçam do meio dos amalequitas, para que eu não os elimine junto com eles. Pois vocês mostraram lealdade a todos os filhos de Israel quando eles subiram do Egito." E os queneus se retiraram do meio de Amaleque.
pt.B: Saul disse aos queneus: "Vão embora, afastem-se dos amalequitas, senão eu vou eliminar vocês junto com eles. Pois vocês mostraram bondade leal a todos os israelitas quando eles subiram do Egito." Então os queneus se afastaram dos amalequitas.
pt.R: Saul disse aos queneus: "Saiam do meio dos amalequitas e vão para longe deles. Se não saírem, vou destruir vocês junto com eles. Vocês foram bondosos e leais com todos os israelitas quando eles subiram do Egito." Então os queneus deixaram os amalequitas.

decisions.choice: the Kenites: the clan of Moses' father-in-law
decisions.reason: The Kenites were a clan linked by marriage to Moses (Judges 1:16; 4:11). Some of them went with Israel from the wilderness and settled in the south among the people of Judah, near the Amalekites.

decisions.choice: steadfast love: loyal kindness beyond what was owed
decisions.reason: The word names faithful, loyal kindness. The Kenites had helped Israel in the wilderness: Moses asked Hobab to be Israel's "eyes" on the journey (Numbers 10:29-32). Saul repays that old kindness by sparing them.

decisions.choice: sweep you away: destroy you along with them
decisions.reason: The verb means to gather in or take away; here it means to remove by death, as a harvest is gathered (compare Psalm 26:9).

decisions.choice: steadfast love (Literal); faithful love (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The book-wide wording for this word is kept, even though the love is shown by people and not by God (m2).

decisions.choice: "amour loyal" (Literal); "amour fidèle" (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note settles for *ḥesed*, between people as toward God: kindness that keeps faith beyond what was owed (m2).

decisions.choice: "amor leal" (L); "amor fiel" (B, R); "los ceneos"
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as the Samuel terms note: *ḥesed* is "amor leal" at Literal and "amor fiel" at Balanced and Readable, also where people show it to one another, as the English keeps its book-wide wording here. The Hebrew turns from plural commands to a singular "you" for the Kenites as one people; Spanish keeps the plural throughout, which reads naturally for a group.

decisions.choice: upendo usiokoma (L); fadhili (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel and Psalms notes: *ḥesed*, here shown between peoples, is "upendo usiokoma" at Literal and "fadhili" at Balanced and Readable. The Kenites are "Wakeni", as the terms note has it.

decisions.choice: "tình yêu thương thành tín" (L); "lòng nhân từ" (B, R) for *ḥesed* shown by the Kenites
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note, also between people; "người Kê-nít" as the published Genesis 15:19.

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (L, B); "변함없는 사랑" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for *ḥesed*, also between people: loyal kindness beyond what was owed (m2). Used for the whole block.

decisions.choice: os filhos de Israel (L); os israelitas (B, R), without a gender span
alternatives: os filhos e as filhas de Israel
decisions.reason: As in docs/pentateuch-portuguese-terms.md: "filhos" already includes daughters, and "israelitas" names the whole people, so Portuguese needs no gender setting where the English has one.

decisions.choice: lealdade (L); bondade leal (B); foram bondosos e leais (R)
decisions.reason: Kindness shown by people (m2), as the book-wide wording for "ḥesed" between people in Ruth and Judges in Portuguese; "amor leal" is kept for the LORD's. "Os queneus" as Judges 1:16.

source.text: וַיַּ֥ךְ שָׁא֖וּל אֶת־עֲמָלֵ֑ק מֵֽחֲוִילָה֙ בּוֹאֲךָ֣ שׁ֔וּר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י מִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And struck Saul Amalek from Havilah [as] your coming [to] Shur, which [is] on [the] face of Egypt.

en.L: And Saul struck Amalek from Havilah as you come to Shur, which [is] east of Egypt.
en.B: Then Saul struck down the Amalekites from Havilah all the way to Shur, which lies east of Egypt.
en.R: Then Saul defeated the Amalekites. He fought them from Havilah all the way to Shur, on the east side of Egypt.

es.L: Y Saúl hirió a Amalec desde Havila hasta la entrada de Shur, que [está] frente a Egipto.
es.B: Luego Saúl derrotó a los amalecitas desde Havila hasta Shur, que está al oriente de Egipto.
es.R: Entonces Saúl venció a los amalecitas. Peleó contra ellos desde Havila hasta Shur, al lado oriental de Egipto.

fr.L: Et Saül frappa Amaleq depuis Havila jusqu’à l’entrée de Shour, qui [est] en face de l’Égypte.
fr.B: Saül battit alors les Amalécites depuis Havila jusqu’à Shour, qui est à l’est de l’Égypte.
fr.R: Ensuite, Saül a vaincu les Amalécites. Il les a combattus depuis Havila jusqu’à Shour, du côté est de l’Égypte.

sw.L: Na Sauli akawapiga Amaleki kuanzia Havila unapoelekea Shuri, ulio mbele ya Misri.
sw.B: Kisha Sauli akawapiga Waamaleki tangu Havila mpaka Shuri, ulio mashariki ya Misri.
sw.R: Kisha Sauli akawashinda Waamaleki. Alipigana nao tangu Havila mpaka Shuri, upande wa mashariki wa Misri.

vi.L: Sau-lơ đánh A-ma-léc từ Ha-vi-la cho đến lối vào Su-rơ, [là nơi] đối diện Ai Cập.
vi.B: Rồi Sau-lơ đánh người A-ma-léc từ Ha-vi-la cho đến tận Su-rơ, ở phía đông Ai Cập.
vi.R: Rồi Sau-lơ đánh bại người A-ma-léc. Ông đánh chúng từ Ha-vi-la cho đến tận Su-rơ, ở phía đông Ai Cập.

ko.L: 그리고 사울이 하윌라에서부터 이집트 앞에 있는 술에 이르기까지 아말렉을 쳤다.
ko.B: 사울은 하윌라에서부터 이집트 동쪽에 있는 술에 이르기까지 아말렉 사람들을 쳤다.
ko.R: 사울은 아말렉 사람들을 무찔렀다. 그는 하윌라에서부터 이집트 동쪽에 있는 술까지 그들과 싸웠다.

pt.L: E Saul feriu Amaleque desde Havilá até a entrada de Sur, que [está] em frente ao Egito.
pt.B: Então Saul derrotou os amalequitas desde Havilá até Sur, que fica a leste do Egito.
pt.R: Então Saul derrotou os amalequitas. Lutou contra eles desde Havilá até Sur, do lado leste do Egito.

decisions.choice: from Havilah to Shur: across the desert lands south of Israel
decisions.reason: The same words mark the lands of Ishmael's descendants in Genesis 25:18. Shur is the desert on Egypt's northeastern border (Genesis 16:7; Exodus 15:22). Where Havilah lay is not known for certain; it was somewhere in the desert to the east or southeast.

decisions.choice: as you come to Shur, which is on the face of Egypt: all the way to Shur, facing Egypt
decisions.reason: "As you come to" is a way of giving directions: on the road toward. "On the face of" means facing or next to; Shur lies on the edge of Egypt, on the side toward Israel, that is, to the east.

decisions.choice: all the way to; east of
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the Hebrew directions (m2).

source.text: וַיִּתְפֹּ֛שׂ אֶת־אֲגַ֥ג מֶֽלֶךְ־עֲמָלֵ֖ק חָ֑י וְאֶת־כָּל־הָעָ֖ם הֶחֱרִ֥ים לְפִי־חָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: And seized Agag king of Amalek alive, and all the people he devoted to destruction by [the] mouth of [the] sword.

en.L: And he seized Agag king of Amalek alive, and all the people he devoted to destruction by the edge of the sword.
en.B: He captured Agag king of Amalek alive, and he devoted all the people to destruction with the sword.
en.R: He captured Agag, the king of the Amalekites, alive. But he destroyed all the people completely with the sword, as given over to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y capturó vivo a Agag rey de Amalec, y a todo el pueblo lo consagró a la destrucción a filo de espada.
es.B: Capturó vivo a Agag, rey de Amalec, y consagró a la destrucción a todo el pueblo a filo de espada.
es.R: Capturó vivo a Agag, el rey de los amalecitas. Pero a todo el pueblo lo destruyó por completo a espada, como pueblo entregado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et il saisit vivant Agag, roi d’Amaleq, et il voua à l’interdit tout le peuple au tranchant de l’épée.
fr.B: Il captura vivant Agag, roi d’Amaleq, et voua tout le peuple à l’interdit en le passant au fil de l’épée.
fr.R: Il a capturé Agag, le roi des Amalécites, vivant. Mais il a détruit complètement tout le peuple avec l’épée, comme une chose donnée {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Naye akamkamata Agagi mfalme wa Amaleki akiwa hai, na watu wote akawaweka wakfu kwa maangamizi kwa makali ya upanga.
sw.B: Akamteka Agagi mfalme wa Amaleki akiwa hai, na watu wote akawaweka wakfu kwa maangamizi kwa upanga.
sw.R: Akamteka Agagi, mfalme wa Waamaleki, akiwa hai. Lakini akawaangamiza kabisa watu wote kwa upanga, kama watu waliotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Ông bắt sống A-ga, vua A-ma-léc, và tận hiến toàn dân cho sự hủy diệt bằng lưỡi gươm.
vi.B: Ông bắt sống A-ga, vua A-ma-léc, và dùng gươm tận diệt toàn dân.
vi.R: Ông bắt sống A-ga, vua của người A-ma-léc. Nhưng ông dùng gươm tiêu diệt hoàn toàn cả dân ấy, như vật đã dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 아말렉 왕 아각을 산 채로 사로잡았고, 모든 백성은 칼날로 진멸했다.
ko.B: 그는 아말렉 왕 아각을 산 채로 사로잡았고, 그 백성은 모두 칼로 진멸했다.
ko.R: 그는 아말렉 사람들의 왕 아각을 산 채로 사로잡았다. 그러나 다른 백성은 모두 칼로 죽여, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바친 것으로 여겨 완전히 없앴다.

pt.L: E ele capturou vivo Agague, rei de Amaleque, e todo o povo consagrou à destruição ao fio da espada.
pt.B: Ele capturou vivo Agague, rei dos amalequitas, e consagrou à destruição todo o povo, ao fio da espada.
pt.R: Ele capturou Agague, o rei dos amalequitas, vivo. Mas destruiu completamente todo o povo com a espada, como coisa entregue {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

decisions.choice: Agag: the king of Amalek
decisions.reason: Balaam names Agag as a great king in Numbers 24:7, so the name may have been carried by more than one king of Amalek. Haman in Esther is called "the Agagite" (Esther 3:1), a descendant of this royal line.

decisions.choice: by the mouth of the sword: with the sword
decisions.reason: The sword is pictured as a mouth that devours; "by the mouth of the sword" means killed in battle with the sword.

decisions.choice: all the people: the Amalekites Saul's army met
decisions.reason: The words speak of the people Saul fought in this campaign. Amalekites appear again later (27:8; 30:1), so the account is not saying that none were left anywhere.

decisions.choice: destroyed ... completely, as given over to the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable explains the term as in verse 3. "But" sets the people's death against the sparing of Agag.

decisions.choice: "A-ga"
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note.

decisions.choice: Agague, rei de Amaleque (L); Agague, rei dos amalequitas (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: "Agague", with the final "-e" Portuguese adds after a consonant, as in Numbers 24:7 in Portuguese. Literal keeps the Hebrew "Amaleque" for the nation; Balanced and Readable name the people, as they do with "os amalequitas" throughout the chapter. "Ao fio da espada" is the book-wide wording of Joshua 6:21.

source.text: וַיַּחְמֹל֩ שָׁא֨וּל וְהָעָ֜ם עַל־אֲגָ֗ג וְעַל־מֵיטַ֣ב הַצֹּאן֩ וְהַבָּקָ֨ר וְהַמִּשְׁנִ֤ים וְעַל־הַכָּרִים֙ וְעַל־כָּל־הַטּ֔וֹב וְלֹ֥א אָב֖וּ הַחֲרִימָ֑ם וְכָל־הַמְּלָאכָ֛ה נְמִבְזָ֥ה וְנָמֵ֖ס אֹתָ֥הּ הֶחֱרִֽימוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And spared Saul and the people Agag, and the best of the sheep and the cattle and the second ones and the lambs and all the good, and not they were willing to devote them to destruction; and all the property despised and worthless, it they devoted to destruction.

en.L: And Saul and the people spared Agag, and the best of the sheep and the cattle, and the fatlings and the lambs, and all that was good, and they were not willing to devote them to destruction. But all the property [that was] despised and worthless, that they devoted to destruction.
en.B: But Saul and the troops spared Agag. They also spared the finest sheep and cattle, the fattened animals and the lambs, and everything that was good. They were not willing to devote these to destruction. Everything that was despised and worthless they devoted to destruction.
en.R: But Saul and his army let Agag live. They also kept the best of the sheep and cattle, the fattest animals and the lambs, and everything else that was good. They did not want to destroy these things. They destroyed only what was weak or worthless.

es.L: Y Saúl y el pueblo perdonaron a Agag, y lo mejor de las ovejas y de las vacas, y los animales cebados y los corderos, y todo lo bueno, y no quisieron consagrarlos a la destrucción. Pero todo lo que [era] despreciable y sin valor, eso consagraron a la destrucción.
es.B: Pero Saúl y la tropa le perdonaron la vida a Agag. También perdonaron lo mejor de las ovejas y de las vacas, los animales cebados y los corderos, y todo lo que era bueno. No quisieron consagrarlo a la destrucción. Lo que era despreciable y sin valor, eso sí lo consagraron a la destrucción.
es.R: Pero Saúl y su ejército dejaron vivir a Agag. También se quedaron con lo mejor de las ovejas y las vacas, los animales más gordos y los corderos, y todo lo demás que era bueno. No quisieron destruir esas cosas. Solo destruyeron lo que era débil o no valía nada.

fr.L: Et Saül et le peuple épargnèrent Agag, et le meilleur du petit bétail et du gros bétail, et les bêtes grasses, et les agneaux, et tout ce qui était bon, et ils ne voulurent pas les vouer à l’interdit ; mais tout le bien méprisable et sans valeur, ils le vouèrent à l’interdit.
fr.B: Mais Saül et la troupe épargnèrent Agag, ainsi que les meilleures têtes de petit et de gros bétail, les bêtes engraissées, les agneaux et tout ce qui avait de la valeur. Ils ne voulurent pas les vouer à l’interdit. Ils vouèrent à l’interdit seulement ce qui était méprisable et sans valeur.
fr.R: Mais Saül et son armée ont laissé Agag en vie. Ils ont aussi gardé les meilleurs moutons et les meilleurs bœufs, les bêtes les plus grasses, les agneaux et tout ce qui était bon. Ils n’ont pas voulu détruire ces choses-là. Ils ont seulement détruit ce qui était faible ou sans valeur.

sw.L: Lakini Sauli na watu wakamhurumia Agagi, na walio bora wa kondoo na ng'ombe, na wanyama wanono na wana-kondoo, na vyote vilivyokuwa vizuri, wala hawakutaka kuviweka wakfu kwa maangamizi. Lakini mali yote [iliyokuwa] duni na isiyofaa, hiyo waliiweka wakfu kwa maangamizi.
sw.B: Lakini Sauli na askari wakamwacha Agagi hai. Wakawaacha pia kondoo na ng'ombe walio bora, wanyama walionona na wana-kondoo, na kila kitu kilichokuwa kizuri. Hawakutaka kuviweka wakfu kwa maangamizi. Kila kitu kilichokuwa duni na kisichofaa ndicho walichokiweka wakfu kwa maangamizi.
sw.R: Lakini Sauli na jeshi lake wakamwacha Agagi hai. Wakajibakizia pia kondoo na ng'ombe walio bora, wanyama walionona sana na wana-kondoo, na kila kitu kingine kilichokuwa kizuri. Hawakutaka kuviangamiza vitu hivyo. Waliangamiza tu vile vilivyokuwa dhaifu au visivyofaa.

vi.L: Sau-lơ và dân chúng tha A-ga, cùng những con tốt nhất trong chiên và bò, những con béo mập, chiên con và mọi thứ tốt, không chịu tận hiến chúng cho sự hủy diệt; còn mọi tài sản bị khinh rẻ và vô giá trị, thì họ tận hiến cho sự hủy diệt.
vi.B: Nhưng Sau-lơ và quân lính tha A-ga. Họ cũng tha những con chiên và bò tốt nhất, những con thú béo mập, chiên con và mọi thứ tốt. Họ không chịu tận diệt những thứ ấy. Chỉ những gì bị khinh rẻ và vô giá trị thì họ mới tận diệt.
vi.R: Nhưng Sau-lơ và quân đội của ông để A-ga sống. Họ cũng giữ lại những con chiên và bò tốt nhất, những con thú béo nhất, chiên con và mọi thứ tốt khác. Họ không muốn tiêu diệt những thứ ấy. Họ chỉ tiêu diệt những gì yếu kém hoặc vô giá trị.

ko.L: 그리고 사울과 백성이 아각과, 양과 소 가운데 가장 좋은 것과, 살진 것들과 어린양들과 모든 좋은 것을 아끼고, 그것들을 진멸하려 하지 않았다. 그러나 천하고 쓸모없는 모든 것은 진멸했다.
ko.B: 그러나 사울과 군대는 아각을 살려 주었다. 또 양과 소 가운데 가장 좋은 것과 살진 짐승과 어린양과 그 밖의 좋은 것은 모두 아껴 두었다. 그들은 그것들을 진멸하려 하지 않았다. 천하고 쓸모없는 것만 모두 진멸했다.
ko.R: 그러나 사울과 그의 군대는 아각을 살려 두었다. 또 양과 소 가운데 가장 좋은 것과 가장 살진 짐승과 어린양과 그 밖의 좋은 것은 모두 남겨 두었다. 그들은 그것들을 없애고 싶지 않았다. 그들은 약하거나 쓸모없는 것만 없앴다.

pt.L: E Saul e o povo pouparam Agague, e o melhor das ovelhas e dos bois, e os animais de segunda cria e os cordeiros, e tudo o que era bom, e não quiseram consagrá-los à destruição. Mas todos os bens [que eram] desprezíveis e sem valor, esses eles consagraram à destruição.
pt.B: Mas Saul e as tropas pouparam Agague. Pouparam também as melhores ovelhas e os melhores bois, os animais engordados e os cordeiros, e tudo o que era bom. Não quiseram consagrar essas coisas à destruição. Tudo o que era desprezível e sem valor eles consagraram à destruição.
pt.R: Mas Saul e o seu exército deixaram Agague vivo. Também ficaram com as melhores ovelhas e os melhores bois, os animais mais gordos e os cordeiros, e com tudo o mais que era bom. Não quiseram destruir essas coisas. Destruíram só o que era fraco ou não valia nada.

decisions.choice: spared: had pity on, held back from destroying
decisions.reason: This is the verb of the command in verse 3, "do not spare him". The narrator uses the same word to show that Saul and the people did exactly what they were told not to do.

decisions.choice: the fatlings: animals of the best quality
alternatives: the animals of the second year
decisions.reason: The word means "second ones". It may name animals of the second birth or second year, thought to be the finest, or it may be a slip for a similar word meaning "fat ones". Either way, it names choice animals kept for their value.

decisions.choice: the property that was despised and worthless: whatever was not worth keeping
decisions.reason: The two descriptive words are unusual forms. The first means despised or of little value; the second probably means wasting away or weak. The contrast with "all that was good" is clear: they destroyed only what they did not want.

decisions.choice: they were not willing: a deliberate choice
decisions.reason: The verb expresses will and consent. Keeping the best was not an oversight in battle but a decision.

decisions.choice: the troops (Balanced); his army (Readable)
decisions.reason: "The people" are Saul's fighting men here (verse 4, m1). Literal keeps "the people".
