pt.R: Então uma mensagem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} veio a Samuel:

decisions.choice: the word of the LORD came to Samuel: the LORD spoke to him as a prophet
decisions.reason: This is the usual way of saying that the LORD gave a prophet a message (3:1, 21; 2 Samuel 7:4). What follows is the LORD's own word about Saul.

decisions.choice: a message from the LORD
decisions.reason: Readable says "message" for "word", since the word is a whole message, not a single word.

source.text: נִחַ֗מְתִּי כִּֽי־הִמְלַ֤כְתִּי אֶת־שָׁאוּל֙ לְמֶ֔לֶךְ כִּֽי־שָׁב֙ מֵאַֽחֲרַ֔י וְאֶת־דְּבָרַ֖י לֹ֣א הֵקִ֑ים וַיִּ֨חַר֙ לִשְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וַיִּזְעַ֥ק אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה כָּל־הַלָּֽיְלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: I regret that I made king Saul as king, for he has turned back from after me, and my words not he has carried out. And it burned to Samuel, and he cried out to Yahweh all the night.

en.L: "I regret that I have made Saul king, for he has turned back from following {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} words he has not carried out." And Samuel was angry, and he cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} all the night.
en.B: "I regret that I made Saul king, because he has turned back from following {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} and has failed to carry out {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} commands." Samuel was angry, and he cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} all night long.
en.R: "I am sorry that I made Saul king. He has turned away from following {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and he has not done what I told him to do." Samuel was angry, and he cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} all night.

es.L: «Me pesa haber hecho rey a Saúl, porque se ha apartado de en pos de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y no ha cumplido {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} palabras». Y Samuel se enojó, y clamó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} toda la noche.
es.B: «Lamento haber hecho rey a Saúl, porque ha dejado de seguir {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} caminos y no ha cumplido {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} mandatos». Samuel se enojó, y estuvo clamando {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} toda la noche.
es.R: «Siento mucho haber hecho rey a Saúl. Se ha apartado de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, y no ha hecho lo que le mandé». Samuel se enojó, y clamó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} toda la noche.

fr.L: « Je regrette d’avoir fait régner Saül comme roi, car il s’est détourné de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, et {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} paroles, il ne les a pas accomplies. » Et Samuel fut irrité, et il cria {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} toute la nuit.
fr.B: « Je regrette d’avoir établi Saül comme roi, car il s’est détourné de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} et n’a pas exécuté {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} ordres. » Samuel en fut irrité, et il cria {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} toute la nuit.
fr.R: « Je regrette d’avoir fait de Saül un roi. Il a cessé de {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} suivre, et il n’a pas fait ce que je lui avais dit de faire. » Samuel a été en colère, et il a crié {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} toute la nuit.

sw.L: "Ninajuta kwamba nimemfanya Sauli kuwa mfalme, kwa maana amerudi nyuma asinifuate {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, wala maneno {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} hakuyatimiza." Na Samweli akakasirika, akamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} usiku kucha.
sw.B: "Ninajuta kwamba nilimfanya Sauli kuwa mfalme, kwa sababu ameacha kunifuata na hakutimiza amri {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}." Samweli akakasirika, akamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} usiku kucha.
sw.R: "Nasikitika kwamba nilimfanya Sauli kuwa mfalme. Ameacha kunifuata, wala hajafanya nilichomwambia afanye." Samweli akakasirika, akamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} usiku mzima.

vi.L: "Ta hối tiếc vì đã lập Sau-lơ làm vua, vì nó đã quay lưng không theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và các lời {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nó đã không thực hiện." Sa-mu-ên nổi giận, và người kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} suốt đêm.
vi.B: "Ta hối tiếc vì đã lập Sau-lơ làm vua, vì nó đã quay lưng không theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và không thực hiện các mệnh lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}." Sa-mu-ên nổi giận, và người kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} suốt đêm.
vi.R: "Ta buồn lòng vì đã lập Sau-lơ làm vua. Nó đã quay lưng không theo {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nữa, và nó đã không làm điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} truyền cho nó." Sa-mu-ên nổi giận, và người kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} suốt đêm.

ko.L: "내가 사울을 왕으로 세운 것을 후회한다. 그가 나를 따르는 데서 돌아섰고, 내 말을 이행하지 않았다." 그러자 사무엘이 분노하여 밤새도록 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖었다.
ko.B: "내가 사울을 왕으로 세운 것을 후회한다. 그가 나를 따르지 않고 돌아섰으며, 내 명령을 이행하지 않았다." 사무엘은 분노하여 밤새도록 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖었다.
ko.R: "내가 사울을 왕으로 세운 것이 마음 아프다. 그는 나를 따르지 않고 돌아섰다. 내가 시킨 일을 하지 않았다." 사무엘은 화가 나서 밤새도록 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖었다.

pt.L: "Arrependo-me de ter feito Saul rei, porque ele se desviou de {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} seguir e não cumpriu as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} palavras." E Samuel ficou irado, e clamou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} a noite toda.
pt.B: "Lamento ter feito Saul rei, porque ele deixou de {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} seguir e não cumpriu as {{deity_pronoun:minhas|Minhas}} ordens." Samuel ficou irado e clamou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} a noite inteira.
pt.R: "Estou triste por ter feito Saul rei. Ele deixou de {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} seguir e não fez o que eu mandei." Samuel ficou irado e clamou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} a noite toda.

decisions.choice: I regret: the LORD's sorrow and change of course, said in human terms
alternatives: I have changed my mind about making Saul king
I am grieved that I made Saul king
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of God in Genesis 6:6 and Exodus 32:14: to be sorry, to grieve, to turn from a course once taken. This chapter uses it three times. The LORD regrets making Saul king (here and verse 35), and yet Samuel says that the Glory of Israel does not regret as a human does (verse 29). The writer sets these a few verses apart, so they are meant to be read together. Here the word speaks of God's grief at Saul's disobedience and of a real change in how he deals with Saul: the kingship given to him will not go on. It does not mean that God made a mistake he could not foresee; the loss of Saul's line had already been announced (13:13-14). Verse 29 adds that this sentence will not be reversed.

decisions.choice: turned back from following me: stopped being loyal to the LORD
decisions.reason: To "go after" someone is to follow and serve them as a loyal subject (12:14, 20). To turn back from following is to break that loyalty.

decisions.choice: my words he has not carried out: he has not done what I commanded
decisions.reason: The verb means to set up, to make stand, and with "words" it means to carry them out. Saul uses the same verb in verse 13 to claim that he has done just that.

decisions.choice: it burned to Samuel: Samuel was angry
decisions.reason: The phrase is the usual way of saying that someone became angry. The verse does not say at whom: at Saul's disobedience, or at the word he had received. The same phrase is used of David in 2 Samuel 6:8, where it may mean deep distress as much as anger.

decisions.choice: I regret (Literal, Balanced); I am sorry (Readable)
decisions.reason: The levels use words of regret and sorrow (m1). "Repent" is avoided at every level, since in English it suggests turning from sin. Readable uses the everyday "I am sorry".

decisions.choice: my commands (Balanced); what I told him to do (Readable)
decisions.reason: "My words" here are the LORD's commands about Amalek (m3).

decisions.choice: "me pesa" (L); "lamento" (B); "siento mucho" (R); in verse 29 "le pesará" (L), "cambiar de parecer" (B, R); in verse 35 "le pesó" (L), "lamentó" (B), "sintió" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English decision: the LORD's sorrow and change of course (m1) is said with words of regret, never "arrepentirse", which in Spanish suggests turning from sin, as the New Testament note sets for *metamelomai*. Literal keeps one verb, "pesar", in verses 11, 29 and 35 so the reader can follow the word.

decisions.choice: ninajuta (L, B); nasikitika (R)
decisions.reason: The LORD's sorrow is said in human terms (m1); Swahili "kujuta" matches the English "regret" and "kusikitika" the Readable "I am sorry", and verse 35 uses the same words.

decisions.choice: "hối tiếc" (L, B); "buồn lòng" (R) for God's regret
decisions.reason: God's sorrow and change of course said in human terms (meaning decision); "ăn năn" would suggest God had sinned. God speaks of Saul as "nó", as a judge speaks of an offender.

decisions.choice: "후회한다" (L, B); "마음 아프다" (R)
decisions.reason: God's sorrow and change of course said in human terms (m1); "후회하다" is the plain word, and Readable says the sorrow, as the English Readable "I am sorry". The same words in verse 35.

decisions.choice: arrepender-se (L); lamentar (B); estar triste (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps one verb for the three places the chapter uses it, here, verse 29 and verse 35, as the English Literal keeps "regret" (m1). In Portuguese "arrepender-se" says regret as well as turning from sin, and Literal needs a verb that can also be denied of God in verse 29. Balanced says "lamentar", which cannot suggest that God had sinned, and Readable says the plain "estar triste", as the English Readable says "sorry".

source.text: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֧ם שְׁמוּאֵ֛ל לִקְרַ֥את שָׁא֖וּל בַּבֹּ֑קֶר וַיֻּגַּ֨ד לִשְׁמוּאֵ֜ל לֵאמֹ֗ר בָּֽא־שָׁא֤וּל הַכַּרְמֶ֨לָה֙ וְהִנֵּ֨ה מַצִּ֥יב לוֹ֙ יָ֔ד וַיִּסֹּב֙ וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֔ר וַיֵּ֖רֶד הַגִּלְגָּֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And rose early Samuel to meet Saul in the morning; and it was told to Samuel, saying, came Saul to Carmel, and look, [he is] setting up for himself a monument, and he turned and passed on and went down [to] Gilgal.

en.L: And Samuel rose early to meet Saul in the morning. And it was told to Samuel, saying, "Saul came to Carmel, and look, he was setting up a monument for himself, and he turned and passed on and went down to Gilgal."
en.B: Samuel got up early in the morning to meet Saul, and Samuel was told, "Saul went to Carmel and set up a monument for himself there. Then he turned and went on down to Gilgal."
en.R: Early the next morning Samuel got up to go and meet Saul. But someone told him, "Saul went to Carmel. He set up a monument there in his own honor. Then he left and went down to Gilgal."

es.L: Y Samuel madrugó para ir al encuentro de Saúl por la mañana. Y se le avisó a Samuel, diciendo: «Saúl fue a Carmel, y he aquí que se erigía un monumento, y dio la vuelta y pasó adelante y bajó a Gilgal».
es.B: Samuel se levantó temprano por la mañana para ir al encuentro de Saúl, y le dijeron: «Saúl fue a Carmel y allí se levantó un monumento. Luego dio la vuelta y siguió bajando hasta Gilgal».
es.R: Muy temprano a la mañana siguiente, Samuel se levantó para ir a encontrarse con Saúl. Pero alguien le dijo: «Saúl fue a Carmel. Allí levantó un monumento en su propio honor. Después se fue y bajó a Gilgal».

fr.L: Et Samuel se leva de bon matin pour aller à la rencontre de Saül. Et on le rapporta à Samuel, en disant : « Saül est venu à Carmel, et voici, il s’érige un monument ; puis il s’est retourné, il est passé plus loin et il est descendu à Guilgal. »
fr.B: Samuel se leva tôt le matin pour aller à la rencontre de Saül, et on lui rapporta : « Saül est allé à Carmel et s’y est dressé un monument. Puis il a fait demi-tour et il est descendu à Guilgal. »
fr.R: Le lendemain, très tôt, Samuel s’est levé pour aller voir Saül. Mais quelqu’un lui a dit : « Saül est allé à Carmel. Il y a dressé un monument en son propre honneur. Ensuite, il est parti et il est descendu à Guilgal. »

sw.L: Na Samweli akaamka mapema ili kumlaki Sauli asubuhi. Na Samweli akaambiwa, kusema, "Sauli alikuja Karmeli, na tazama, alikuwa akijisimamishia mnara wa ukumbusho, kisha akageuka akapita akashuka Gilgali."
sw.B: Samweli akaamka asubuhi na mapema ili kwenda kumlaki Sauli, na Samweli akaambiwa, "Sauli alikwenda Karmeli akajisimamishia mnara wa ukumbusho huko. Kisha akageuka akaendelea kushuka mpaka Gilgali."
sw.R: Asubuhi na mapema siku iliyofuata Samweli akaamka ili kwenda kumlaki Sauli. Lakini mtu mmoja akamwambia, "Sauli alikwenda Karmeli. Huko alisimamisha mnara wa ukumbusho kwa heshima yake mwenyewe. Kisha akaondoka akashuka Gilgali."

vi.L: Sáng sớm Sa-mu-ên dậy để đi gặp Sau-lơ. Có người báo cho Sa-mu-ên rằng: "Sau-lơ đã đến Cạt-mên, và kìa, ông ấy dựng cho mình một đài kỷ niệm, rồi quay đi tiếp, xuống Ghinh-ganh."
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên dậy sớm để đi gặp Sau-lơ, thì có người báo cho Sa-mu-ên: "Sau-lơ đã đến Cạt-mên và dựng cho mình một đài kỷ niệm ở đó. Rồi ông ấy quay đi xuống Ghinh-ganh."
vi.R: Sáng sớm hôm sau Sa-mu-ên dậy để đi gặp Sau-lơ. Nhưng có người báo cho người: "Sau-lơ đã đến Cạt-mên. Ông ấy dựng tại đó một đài kỷ niệm để tôn vinh chính mình. Rồi ông ấy rời đó đi xuống Ghinh-ganh."

ko.L: 그리고 사무엘이 아침에 사울을 만나려고 일찍 일어났다. 그런데 사무엘에게 이런 말이 전해졌다. "사울이 갈멜에 와서, 보십시오, 자기를 위해 기념비를 세우고, 돌아서 지나 길갈로 내려갔습니다."
ko.B: 사무엘은 사울을 만나려고 아침 일찍 일어났다. 그런데 사무엘에게 이런 소식이 들려왔다. "사울이 갈멜에 가서 자기를 위해 기념비를 세웠습니다. 그리고 거기서 돌아서 길갈로 내려갔습니다."
ko.R: 다음 날 아침 일찍 사무엘은 사울을 만나러 가려고 일어났다. 그런데 누군가 사무엘에게 말했다. "사울이 갈멜에 가서 자기를 높이려고 기념비를 세웠습니다. 그러고는 그곳을 떠나 길갈로 내려갔습니다."

pt.L: E Samuel se levantou cedo para encontrar Saul de manhã. E foi dito a Samuel: "Saul foi ao Carmelo, e eis que estava levantando um monumento para si, e deu a volta, e passou adiante, e desceu a Gilgal."
pt.B: Samuel se levantou cedo de manhã para ir ao encontro de Saul, e lhe disseram: "Saul foi ao Carmelo e levantou ali um monumento para si mesmo. Depois deu a volta e desceu para Gilgal."
pt.R: Bem cedo na manhã seguinte, Samuel se levantou para ir encontrar Saul. Mas alguém lhe contou: "Saul foi ao Carmelo. Levantou ali um monumento em sua própria honra. Depois saiu de lá e desceu para Gilgal."

decisions.choice: Carmel: a town in the hill country of Judah
decisions.reason: This Carmel lay south of Hebron (Joshua 15:55; 1 Samuel 25:2), on Saul's way back from the south. It is not Mount Carmel in the north.

decisions.choice: setting up a monument for himself: a memorial to his own victory
decisions.reason: The word is "hand", used of a standing stone or marker that keeps a name in memory (2 Samuel 18:18). "For himself" shows whom it honored. The report sets Saul's self-honor beside his neglect of the LORD's command.

decisions.choice: Gilgal: the place where Saul was made king
decisions.reason: At Gilgal the people had renewed Saul's kingship before the LORD (11:14-15), and there Saul had earlier gone against Samuel's word (13:8-14). Now he goes there to offer sacrifices (verse 21).

decisions.choice: set up a monument for himself there (Balanced); in his own honor (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable leave out "look", which marks something surprising in the report, and tell the steps in order. Readable says "in his own honor" for "for himself" (m2).

decisions.choice: "Cạt-mên"
decisions.reason: The usual Protestant form; this is the town in Judah (meaning decision), not Mount Carmel.

source.text: וַיָּבֹ֥א שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל אֶל־שָׁא֑וּל וַיֹּ֧אמֶר ל֣וֹ שָׁא֗וּל בָּר֤וּךְ אַתָּה֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה הֲקִימֹ֖תִי אֶת־דְּבַ֥ר יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And came Samuel to Saul, and said to him Saul, blessed [are] you to Yahweh; I have carried out [the] word of Yahweh.

en.L: And Samuel came to Saul, and Saul said to him, "Blessed [are] you to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! I have carried out the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: When Samuel reached Saul, Saul greeted him, "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} bless you! I have carried out the command of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: When Samuel got there, Saul greeted him: "May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} bless you! I have done what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} told me to do."

es.L: Y Samuel llegó a Saúl, y Saúl le dijo: «¡Bendito [seas] tú {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}! He cumplido la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».
es.B: Cuando Samuel llegó adonde estaba Saúl, este lo saludó: «¡Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te bendiga! He cumplido el mandato {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}».
es.R: Cuando Samuel llegó, Saúl lo saludó: «¡Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te bendiga! He hecho lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me mandó».

fr.L: Et Samuel arriva vers Saül, et Saül lui dit : « Béni sois-tu {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! J’ai accompli la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Quand Samuel rejoignit Saül, celui-ci l’accueillit en disant : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te bénisse ! J’ai exécuté l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Quand Samuel est arrivé, Saül l’a accueilli : « Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} te bénisse ! J’ai fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit de faire. »

sw.L: Na Samweli akamfikia Sauli, na Sauli akamwambia, "Umebarikiwa na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Nimelitimiza neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Samweli alipomfikia Sauli, Sauli akamsalimu, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akubariki! Nimeitimiza amri ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Samweli alipofika huko, Sauli akamsalimu: "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na akubariki! Nimefanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoniambia nifanye."

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên đến cùng Sau-lơ, và Sau-lơ nói với người: "Nguyện ông được {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước! Tôi đã thực hiện lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.B: Khi Sa-mu-ên đến, Sau-lơ chào người: "Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho ông! Tôi đã thực hiện mệnh lệnh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.R: Khi Sa-mu-ên đến nơi, Sau-lơ chào người: "Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ban phước cho ông! Tôi đã làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} truyền cho tôi."

ko.L: 그리고 사무엘이 사울에게 오자, 사울이 그에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 복을 받으시기를 바랍니다! 제가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 이행했습니다."
ko.B: 사무엘이 사울에게 이르자, 사울이 그에게 인사했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 어른께 복을 주시기를 빕니다! 제가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령을 이행했습니다."
ko.R: 사무엘이 도착하자, 사울이 인사했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 어른께 복을 주시기를 빕니다! 제가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 시키신 일을 다 했습니다."

pt.L: E Samuel chegou a Saul, e Saul lhe disse: "Bendito [seja o senhor] {{divine_name:pelo SENHOR|por Javé}}! Eu cumpri a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}."
pt.B: Quando Samuel chegou até Saul, Saul o saudou: "Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} o abençoe! Eu cumpri a ordem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}."
pt.R: Quando Samuel chegou, Saul o cumprimentou: "Que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} o abençoe! Eu fiz o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me mandou fazer."

decisions.choice: blessed are you to the LORD: may the LORD bless you
decisions.reason: This is a greeting that is also a prayer for blessing (Ruth 2:20; 2 Samuel 2:5). Saul greets Samuel warmly, as if all were well.

decisions.choice: I have carried out: the verb the LORD used in verse 11
decisions.reason: The LORD had said, "my words he has not carried out". Saul claims, with the same verb, that he has. The reader already knows that his claim is false.

decisions.choice: the command of the LORD (Balanced); what the LORD told me to do (Readable)
decisions.reason: "The word of the LORD" here is the command about Amalek.

decisions.choice: Bendito [seja o senhor] (L); Que o SENHOR o abençoe (B, R)
decisions.reason: Saul speaks to Samuel with "o senhor" (13:11). Where it would stand next to "o SENHOR", the name of God, Balanced and Readable use the pronoun "o" alone, so that the two words are not confused when read aloud.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל וּמֶ֛ה קֽוֹל־הַצֹּ֥אן הַזֶּ֖ה בְּאָזְנָ֑י וְק֣וֹל הַבָּקָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָנֹכִ֖י שֹׁמֵֽעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Samuel, and what [is] the sound of the sheep the this in my ears, and [the] sound of the cattle which I [am] hearing?

en.L: And Samuel said, "Then what [is] this sound of sheep in my ears, and the sound of cattle that I hear?"
en.B: Samuel replied, "Then what is this bleating of sheep that fills my ears, and the lowing of cattle that I can hear?"
en.R: But Samuel asked, "Then what is all this noise of sheep and cattle that I can hear?"

es.L: Y Samuel dijo: «¿Y qué [es] este sonido de ovejas en mis oídos, y el sonido de vacas que oigo?».
es.B: Samuel le respondió: «¿Y qué son esos balidos de ovejas que me llenan los oídos, y esos mugidos de vacas que oigo?».
es.R: Pero Samuel le preguntó: «¿Entonces qué es todo este ruido de ovejas y vacas que oigo?».

fr.L: Et Samuel dit : « Et qu’[est] ce bruit de moutons à mes oreilles, et ce bruit de bœufs que j’entends ? »
fr.B: Samuel répondit : « Mais alors, que sont ces bêlements de moutons qui parviennent à mes oreilles, et ces meuglements de bœufs que j’entends ? »
fr.R: Mais Samuel a demandé : « Alors, c’est quoi, tout ce bruit de moutons et de bœufs que j’entends ? »

sw.L: Na Samweli akasema, "Basi ni [nini] sauti hii ya kondoo masikioni mwangu, na sauti ya ng'ombe ninayoisikia?"
sw.B: Samweli akajibu, "Basi ni nini mlio huu wa kondoo unaojaa masikioni mwangu, na mlio wa ng'ombe ninaousikia?"
sw.R: Lakini Samweli akauliza, "Basi ni nini kelele hizi zote za kondoo na ng'ombe ninazozisikia?"

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nói: "Vậy tiếng chiên này trong tai tôi, và tiếng bò mà tôi đang nghe [là] gì?"
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên đáp: "Vậy tiếng chiên kêu vang trong tai tôi và tiếng bò rống mà tôi đang nghe là gì?"
vi.R: Nhưng Sa-mu-ên hỏi: "Vậy tiếng chiên kêu bò rống ồn ào mà tôi đang nghe đây là gì?"

ko.L: 그러자 사무엘이 말했다. "그러면 내 귀에 들리는 이 양의 소리와 내가 듣고 있는 소의 소리는 무엇이냐?"
ko.B: 사무엘이 말했다. "그러면 내 귀에 들리는 이 양 떼의 울음소리와 소 떼의 울음소리는 무엇이냐?"
ko.R: 그러자 사무엘이 물었다. "그러면 내게 들리는 이 양과 소의 시끄러운 울음소리는 다 무엇이냐?"

pt.L: E Samuel disse: "E que [é] este som de ovelhas nos meus ouvidos, e o som de bois que eu ouço?"
pt.B: Samuel respondeu: "Então, que balido de ovelhas é este que enche os meus ouvidos, e que mugido de bois é este que eu ouço?"
pt.R: Mas Samuel perguntou: "Então, que barulho todo é este de ovelhas e bois que eu estou ouvindo?"

decisions.choice: sound: the word used for "voice" in "listen to the voice of the LORD"
decisions.reason: The word means both "sound" and "voice". Saul was told to listen to the voice of the LORD (verse 1), and now the voice of the animals he kept gives him away (compare verses 19, 22, 24).

decisions.choice: and what is this: a question that exposes the claim
decisions.reason: The question starts with "and": Saul says he has obeyed, and then what is this noise? It answers his claim without stating the charge.

decisions.choice: bleating; lowing
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the words for the sounds that sheep and cattle make. Literal keeps "sound" twice to show the link with "voice" (m1); Readable says "noise".

decisions.choice: sauti (L); mlio (B)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word for the animals' noise is the word for "voice" in "listen to the voice of the LORD" (m1); Literal keeps "sauti" so the echo can be heard in Swahili too.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל מֵעֲמָלֵקִ֣י הֱבִיא֗וּם אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָמַ֤ל הָעָם֙ עַל־מֵיטַ֤ב הַצֹּאן֙ וְהַבָּקָ֔ר לְמַ֥עַן זְבֹ֖חַ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְאֶת־הַיּוֹתֵ֖ר הֶחֱרַֽמְנוּ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And said Saul, from [the] Amalekites they brought them, which spared the people the best of the sheep and the cattle so as to sacrifice to Yahweh your God; and the rest we devoted to destruction.

en.L: And Saul said, "They brought them from the Amalekites, for the people spared the best of the sheep and the cattle in order to sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. And the rest we devoted to destruction."
en.B: Saul answered, "They brought them from the Amalekites. The troops kept back the best of the sheep and cattle as sacrifices for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God, and everything else we devoted to destruction."
en.R: Saul answered, "The soldiers brought them from the Amalekites. They kept the best of the sheep and cattle to offer as sacrifices to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God. But we destroyed everything else completely, as given over to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

es.L: Y Saúl dijo: «De los amalecitas los han traído, porque el pueblo perdonó lo mejor de las ovejas y de las vacas para sacrificar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios. Y lo demás lo hemos consagrado a la destrucción».
es.B: Saúl respondió: «Los trajeron de los amalecitas. La tropa se quedó con lo mejor de las ovejas y de las vacas para ofrecerlo en sacrificio {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios, y todo lo demás lo hemos consagrado a la destrucción».
es.R: Saúl respondió: «Los soldados los trajeron de los amalecitas. Se quedaron con lo mejor de las ovejas y las vacas para ofrecerlo en sacrificio {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios. Pero todo lo demás lo destruimos por completo, como entregado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et Saül dit : « C’est de chez les Amalécites qu’on les a amenés, car le peuple a épargné le meilleur du petit bétail et du gros bétail pour sacrifier {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Et le reste, nous l’avons voué à l’interdit. »
fr.B: Saül répondit : « On les a amenés de chez les Amalécites. La troupe a gardé les meilleures têtes de petit et de gros bétail pour les offrir en sacrifice {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu, et tout le reste, nous l’avons voué à l’interdit. »
fr.R: Saül a répondu : « Les soldats les ont ramenés de chez les Amalécites. Ils ont gardé les meilleurs moutons et les meilleurs bœufs pour les offrir en sacrifice {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu. Mais nous avons détruit complètement tout le reste, comme une chose donnée {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. »

sw.L: Na Sauli akasema, "Wamewaleta kutoka kwa Waamaleki, kwa maana watu waliwahurumia walio bora wa kondoo na ng'ombe ili kumtolea dhabihu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Na wengine tumewaweka wakfu kwa maangamizi."
sw.B: Sauli akajibu, "Wamewaleta kutoka kwa Waamaleki. Askari waliwabakiza kondoo na ng'ombe walio bora ili wawe dhabihu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako, na vingine vyote tumeviweka wakfu kwa maangamizi."
sw.R: Sauli akajibu, "Askari wamewaleta kutoka kwa Waamaleki. Waliwabakiza kondoo na ng'ombe walio bora ili wawatoe kuwa dhabihu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako. Lakini vingine vyote tumeviangamiza kabisa, kama vitu vilivyotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

vi.L: Sau-lơ nói: "Người ta đã đem chúng từ người A-ma-léc về, vì dân chúng đã tha những con tốt nhất trong chiên và bò để dâng sinh tế cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông. Còn phần còn lại thì chúng tôi đã tận hiến cho sự hủy diệt."
vi.B: Sau-lơ đáp: "Người ta đem chúng về từ người A-ma-léc. Quân lính đã giữ lại những con chiên và bò tốt nhất để dâng sinh tế cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông, còn mọi thứ khác thì chúng tôi đã tận diệt."
vi.R: Sau-lơ đáp: "Quân lính đã đem chúng về từ người A-ma-léc. Họ giữ lại những con chiên và bò tốt nhất để dâng sinh tế cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông. Còn mọi thứ khác thì chúng tôi đã tiêu diệt hoàn toàn, như vật đã dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."

ko.L: 그러자 사울이 말했다. "아말렉 사람들에게서 그들이 그것들을 끌고 왔습니다. 백성이 어른의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제사를 드리려고 양과 소 가운데 가장 좋은 것을 아꼈습니다. 그리고 나머지는 우리가 진멸했습니다."
ko.B: 사울이 대답했다. "군대가 아말렉 사람들에게서 끌고 왔습니다. 그들이 어른의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제물로 드리려고 양과 소 가운데 가장 좋은 것을 남겨 두었습니다. 그리고 나머지는 우리가 다 진멸했습니다."
ko.R: 사울이 대답했다. "군인들이 아말렉 사람들에게서 끌고 왔습니다. 그들이 어른의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제물로 바치려고 양과 소 가운데 가장 좋은 것을 남겨 두었습니다. 그러나 나머지는 우리가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바친 것으로 여겨 모두 없앴습니다."

pt.L: E Saul disse: "Eles os trouxeram dos amalequitas, porque o povo poupou o melhor das ovelhas e dos bois para sacrificar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus. E o resto nós consagramos à destruição."
pt.B: Saul respondeu: "Eles os trouxeram dos amalequitas. As tropas guardaram as melhores ovelhas e os melhores bois para sacrificá-los {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, e todo o resto nós consagramos à destruição."
pt.R: Saul respondeu: "Os soldados trouxeram os animais dos amalequitas. Eles ficaram com as melhores ovelhas e os melhores bois para oferecer como sacrifício {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus. Mas todo o resto nós destruímos completamente, como coisa entregue {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}."

decisions.choice: they brought ... we devoted: Saul gives the blame to the people and keeps the credit
decisions.reason: Saul says "they" brought the animals and "the people" spared them, but "we" destroyed the rest. Verse 9 has already said that Saul and the people spared them together.

decisions.choice: the LORD your God: Saul speaks of the LORD as Samuel's God
decisions.reason: Saul says "your God" here and again in verses 21 and 30. It may be only a respectful way of speaking to a prophet, but beside his excuses it sounds distant, as if the LORD were Samuel's concern more than his own.

decisions.choice: for: the reason the animals were brought
decisions.reason: The connecting word can mean "which" or "because". Read as "because", it gives Saul's reason: the animals were kept for sacrifice.

decisions.choice: the troops / the soldiers; destroyed ... completely, as given over to the LORD (Readable)
decisions.reason: "The people" are the army (verse 4). Readable explains the term as in verse 3, so it names the LORD twice.

decisions.choice: "어른의 하나님"
decisions.reason: Saul speaks of the LORD as Samuel's God (m2); "어른의" keeps "your" with the respect Saul shows the prophet. Used again in verses 21 and 30.

source.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵל֙ אֶל־שָׁא֔וּל הֶ֚רֶף וְאַגִּ֣ידָה לְּךָ֔ אֵת֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֵלַ֖י הַלָּ֑יְלָה וַיֹּ֥אמֶר ל֖וֹ דַּבֵּֽר׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And said Samuel to Saul, stop, and let me tell you what spoke Yahweh to me the night. And he said to him, speak.

en.L: And Samuel said to Saul, "Stop, and let me tell you what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} spoke to me this night." And he said to him, "Speak."
en.B: "Enough!" Samuel said to Saul. "Let me tell you what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} told me during the night." "Go on," Saul answered.
en.R: "Stop!" Samuel said to Saul. "I will tell you what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} told me during the night." "Tell me," Saul said.

es.L: Y Samuel dijo a Saúl: «Detente, y te declararé lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me habló esta noche». Y él le dijo: «Habla».
es.B: «¡Basta!», le dijo Samuel a Saúl. «Déjame decirte lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo durante la noche». «Dímelo», respondió Saúl.
es.R: «¡Basta!», le dijo Samuel a Saúl. «Te voy a decir lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me dijo durante la noche». «Dímelo», dijo Saúl.

fr.L: Et Samuel dit à Saül : « Arrête, et laisse-moi te dire ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit cette nuit. » Et il lui dit : « Parle. »
fr.B: « Assez ! dit Samuel à Saül. Laisse-moi te dire ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit cette nuit. » « Parle », répondit Saül.
fr.R: « Arrête ! a dit Samuel à Saül. Je vais te dire ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a dit pendant la nuit. » « Dis-le-moi », a dit Saül.

sw.L: Na Samweli akamwambia Sauli, "Acha, nami nitakuambia yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoniambia usiku huu." Naye akamwambia, "Sema."
sw.B: Samweli akamwambia Sauli, "Inatosha! Niache nikuambie yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoniambia usiku." Sauli akajibu, "Endelea."
sw.R: Samweli akamwambia Sauli, "Acha!" Akasema, "Nitakuambia yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyoniambia usiku." Sauli akasema, "Niambie."

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nói với Sau-lơ: "Thôi đi, để tôi nói cho ông biết điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với tôi đêm nay." Ông nói với người: "Xin ông cứ nói."
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên nói với Sau-lơ: "Đủ rồi! Để tôi nói cho ông biết điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với tôi đêm qua." Sau-lơ đáp: "Xin ông cứ nói."
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên nói với Sau-lơ: "Thôi đi! Tôi sẽ nói cho ông biết điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với tôi đêm qua." Sau-lơ nói: "Xin ông nói đi."

ko.L: 그러자 사무엘이 사울에게 말했다. "그만두어라. 지난밤에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내게 말씀하신 것을 네게 알려 주겠다." 그러자 그가 그에게 말했다. "말씀하십시오."
ko.B: 사무엘이 사울에게 말했다. "그만하여라! 지난밤에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내게 하신 말씀을 들려주겠다." 사울이 대답했다. "말씀하십시오."
ko.R: 사무엘이 사울에게 말했다. "그만! 지난밤에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 내게 하신 말씀을 알려 주겠다." 사울이 말했다. "말씀해 주십시오."

pt.L: E Samuel disse a Saul: "Pare, e eu lhe contarei o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me falou esta noite." E ele lhe disse: "Fale."
pt.B: "Basta!", disse Samuel a Saul. "Deixe-me contar o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse durante a noite." "Pode falar", respondeu Saul.
pt.R: "Pare!", disse Samuel a Saul. "Vou contar a você o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me disse durante a noite." "Conte", disse Saul.

decisions.choice: stop: enough, say no more
decisions.reason: The verb means to let go or leave off. Samuel cuts short Saul's explanations.

decisions.choice: this night: the night just past
decisions.reason: "The night" is the night in which the LORD spoke and Samuel cried out (verses 10-11).

decisions.choice: he said: Saul answers
decisions.reason: The consonants as written give "they said"; the reading tradition of the Hebrew text has "he said", which is followed here. Either way it is Saul's side that answers "Speak".

decisions.choice: "Go on," Saul answered (Balanced); "Tell me," Saul said (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Saul as the speaker and give the single word "Speak" as "Go on" or "Tell me". Samuel's "Stop!" is put first, ahead of the speaker, to show how sharply he cuts Saul off.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל הֲל֗וֹא אִם־קָטֹ֤ן אַתָּה֙ בְּעֵינֶ֔יךָ רֹ֛אשׁ שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אָ֑תָּה וַיִּמְשָׁחֲךָ֧ יְהוָ֛ה לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Samuel, [is it] not, though small you [were] in your eyes, head of [the] tribes of Israel you [are]? And anointed you Yahweh as king over Israel.

en.L: And Samuel said, "Though you [were] small in your own eyes, [are] you not the head of the tribes of Israel? And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} anointed you king over Israel.
en.B: Samuel said, "Even if you were small in your own eyes, are you not head over the tribes of Israel? {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} anointed you as Israel's king.
en.R: Samuel said, "You once thought you were not important. But you are the leader of the tribes of Israel! {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} anointed you as king over Israel.

es.L: Y Samuel dijo: «Aunque [eras] pequeño a tus propios ojos, ¿no [eres] tú cabeza de las tribus de Israel? Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ungió como rey sobre Israel.
es.B: Samuel dijo: «Aunque te tenías por poca cosa, ¿no eres tú el jefe de las tribus de Israel? {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ungió como rey de Israel.
es.R: Samuel le dijo: «Antes pensabas que no eras importante. ¡Pero eres el líder de las tribus de Israel! {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te ungió como rey sobre Israel.

fr.L: Et Samuel dit : « Bien que tu [fusses] petit à tes propres yeux, n’[es-tu] pas le chef des tribus d’Israël ? Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a oint comme roi sur Israël.
fr.B: Samuel dit : « Même si tu te trouvais petit à tes propres yeux, n’es-tu pas à la tête des tribus d’Israël ? {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a oint comme roi d’Israël.
fr.R: Samuel a dit : « Autrefois, tu pensais que tu n’étais pas important. Mais tu es le chef des tribus d’Israël ! {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a oint comme roi d’Israël.

sw.L: Na Samweli akasema, "Ingawa [ulikuwa] mdogo machoni pako mwenyewe, je, wewe si kichwa cha makabila ya Israeli? Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikupaka mafuta uwe mfalme juu ya Israeli.
sw.B: Samweli akasema, "Hata kama ulijiona mdogo machoni pako, je, wewe si kichwa juu ya makabila ya Israeli? {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikupaka mafuta uwe mfalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Samweli akasema, "Zamani ulijiona kuwa si kitu. Lakini wewe ni kiongozi wa makabila ya Israeli! {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikupaka mafuta uwe mfalme juu ya Israeli.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nói: "Dù ông [đã] nhỏ bé trong mắt mình, chẳng phải ông [là] đầu của các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xức dầu cho ông làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên nói: "Dù ông đã tự thấy mình nhỏ bé, chẳng phải ông là người đứng đầu các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên sao? {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xức dầu cho ông làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên nói: "Trước kia ông nghĩ mình chẳng quan trọng gì. Nhưng ông là người lãnh đạo các chi tộc Y-sơ-ra-ên! {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã xức dầu cho ông làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 사무엘이 말했다. "네가 네 눈에 작게 보였을지라도, 너는 이스라엘 지파들의 머리가 [아니냐]? 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 기름을 부어 이스라엘 위에 왕으로 삼으셨다.
ko.B: 사무엘이 말했다. "네가 스스로 작게 여겼을지라도, 너는 이스라엘 지파들의 우두머리가 아니냐? {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 기름을 부어 이스라엘의 왕으로 세우셨다.
ko.R: 사무엘이 말했다. "너는 전에 네가 보잘것없는 사람이라고 생각했다. 그러나 너는 이스라엘 지파들의 지도자다! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 기름을 부어 이스라엘의 왕으로 세우셨다.

pt.L: E Samuel disse: "Embora você [fosse] pequeno aos seus próprios olhos, não [é] você o chefe das tribos de Israel? E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ungiu você como rei sobre Israel.
pt.B: Samuel disse: "Mesmo que você se achasse pequeno, não é você o chefe das tribos de Israel? {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ungiu você como rei de Israel.
pt.R: Samuel disse: "Antes você achava que não era importante. Mas você é o líder das tribos de Israel! {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} ungiu você como rei sobre Israel.

decisions.choice: small in your own eyes: Saul's humble beginning
decisions.reason: Samuel recalls how Saul spoke of himself when he was first chosen: from the smallest tribe and the least of its clans (9:21), and hiding among the baggage on the day he was named king (10:22). The LORD raised him from that.

decisions.choice: are you not the head: a question that expects "yes"
decisions.reason: The question reminds Saul of his position and so of his duty. As head of the tribes, he could not hide behind what the people wanted (verse 24).

decisions.choice: But you are the leader of the tribes of Israel!
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question into the statement it implies (m2) and says "leader" for "head".

source.text: וַיִּשְׁלָחֲךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה בְּדָ֑רֶךְ וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לֵ֣ךְ וְהַחֲרַמְתָּ֞ה אֶת־הַֽחַטָּאִים֙ אֶת־עֲמָלֵ֔ק וְנִלְחַמְתָּ֣ ב֔וֹ עַ֥ד כַּלּוֹתָ֖ם אֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And sent you Yahweh on a way and said, go and devote to destruction the sinners, Amalek, and fight against him until finishing them.

en.L: And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent you on a journey and said, 'Go, and devote to destruction the sinners, Amalek, and fight against them until you have finished them off.'
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} sent you on a mission and said, 'Go and devote to destruction those sinners, the Amalekites. Fight against them until you have wiped them out.'
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} sent you on a mission. He told you, 'Go and destroy those sinful Amalekites completely, as given over to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Fight against them until they are all gone.'

es.L: Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te envió en un camino y dijo: “Ve y consagra a la destrucción a los pecadores, a Amalec, y pelea contra ellos hasta acabarlos”.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te envió en una misión y te dijo: “Ve y consagra a la destrucción a esos pecadores, los amalecitas. Pelea contra ellos hasta exterminarlos”.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te envió en una misión. Te dijo: “Ve y destruye por completo a esos pecadores, los amalecitas, como pueblo entregado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}. Pelea contra ellos hasta que no quede ninguno”.

fr.L: Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a envoyé en chemin et t’a dit : “Va, et voue à l’interdit les pécheurs, Amaleq, et combats contre eux jusqu’à ce que tu les aies exterminés.”
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a confié une mission en disant : “Va, voue à l’interdit ces pécheurs, les Amalécites. Combats-les jusqu’à ce que tu les aies anéantis.”
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’a confié une mission. Il t’a dit : “Va détruire complètement ces Amalécites pécheurs, comme une chose donnée {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Combats-les jusqu’à ce qu’il n’en reste plus aucun.”

sw.L: Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akakutuma safarini, akasema, 'Nenda ukawaweke wakfu kwa maangamizi wenye dhambi, Amaleki, na upigane nao mpaka uwamalize.'
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikutuma kwa kazi maalumu akasema, 'Nenda ukawaweke wakfu kwa maangamizi wale wenye dhambi, Waamaleki. Pigana nao mpaka uwafutilie mbali.'
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alikutuma kwa kazi maalumu. Alikuambia, 'Nenda ukawaangamize kabisa Waamaleki hao wenye dhambi, kama watu waliotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Pigana nao mpaka wote wakwishe.'

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai ông lên đường và phán: 'Hãy đi tận hiến cho sự hủy diệt những kẻ tội lỗi, là A-ma-léc, và hãy đánh chúng cho đến khi tiêu diệt hết chúng.'
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai ông đi làm một sứ mạng và phán: 'Hãy đi tận diệt bọn tội lỗi ấy, là người A-ma-léc. Hãy đánh chúng cho đến khi quét sạch chúng.'
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã sai ông đi làm một sứ mạng. Ngài phán với ông: 'Hãy đi tiêu diệt hoàn toàn bọn A-ma-léc tội lỗi ấy, như vật đã dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Hãy đánh chúng cho đến khi chúng không còn ai.'

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너를 길로 보내시며 말씀하셨다. '가서 죄인들인 아말렉을 진멸하고, 그들을 끝장낼 때까지 그들과 싸워라.'
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 임무를 맡겨 보내시며 말씀하셨다. '가서 저 죄인들, 곧 아말렉 사람들을 진멸하여라. 그들을 없앨 때까지 그들과 싸워라.'
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 너에게 일을 맡겨 보내셨다. 그분께서 너에게 말씀하셨다. '가서 저 죄 많은 아말렉 사람들을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바친 것으로 여겨 완전히 없애라. 그들이 모두 없어질 때까지 그들과 싸워라.'

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} enviou você num caminho e disse: 'Vai, e consagra à destruição os pecadores, Amaleque, e luta contra eles até que os tenhas exterminado.'
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} enviou você numa missão e disse: 'Vai e consagra à destruição aqueles pecadores, os amalequitas. Luta contra eles até exterminá-los.'
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} enviou você numa missão. Ele disse a você: 'Vai e destrói completamente aqueles amalequitas pecadores, como coisa entregue {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Luta contra eles até não sobrar nenhum.'

decisions.choice: the sinners: a people under judgment for their wrongs
decisions.reason: The LORD's command is a sentence for what Amalek had done (verse 2), not a war for land or plunder. The word is used of the people of Sodom in Genesis 13:13.

decisions.choice: until finishing them: until Amalek has been wiped out
decisions.reason: The Hebrew form is unusual, something like "until their finishing them". It is best read as "until you have finished them off", the goal of the campaign.

decisions.choice: on a way: on a mission
decisions.reason: "Way" here is a journey with a purpose, an errand the LORD gave. Saul uses the same word in verse 20.

decisions.choice: mission; those sinners / those sinful Amalekites
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "mission" for "way" (m3). Readable explains the command as in verse 3.

source.text: וְלָ֥מָּה לֹא־שָׁמַ֖עְתָּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וַתַּ֨עַט֙ אֶל־הַשָּׁלָ֔ל וַתַּ֥עַשׂ הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And why not did you listen to [the] voice of Yahweh, and you swooped on the plunder and did the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh?

en.L: And why did you not listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, but swooped on the plunder and did the evil in the eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?"
en.B: Why did you not obey the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? Why did you pounce on the plunder and do what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}?"
en.R: Why did you not obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? Why did you rush to grab the plunder? You did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil."

es.L: ¿Y por qué no escuchaste la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, sino que te lanzaste sobre el botín e hiciste lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?».
es.B: ¿Por qué no obedeciste la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? ¿Por qué te abalanzaste sobre el botín e hiciste lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}?».
es.R: ¿Por qué no obedeciste {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}? ¿Por qué te lanzaste a agarrar el botín? Hiciste lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice que es malo».

fr.L: Et pourquoi n’as-tu pas écouté la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et t’es-tu jeté sur le butin, et as-tu fait ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? »
fr.B: Pourquoi n’as-tu pas obéi à la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? Pourquoi t’es-tu jeté sur le butin et as-tu fait ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? »
fr.R: Pourquoi n’as-tu pas obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ? Pourquoi t’es-tu précipité pour prendre le butin ? Tu as fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclare mauvais. »

sw.L: Basi kwa nini hukuisikiliza sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, bali ukazirukia nyara na kutenda yaliyo maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?"
sw.B: Kwa nini hukuitii sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Kwa nini ulizirukia nyara na kutenda yaliyo maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}?"
sw.R: Kwa nini hukumtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? Kwa nini ulikimbilia kunyakua nyara? Ulifanya yale ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anasema ni maovu."

vi.L: Sao ông không nghe theo tiếng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, mà lại xông vào chiến lợi phẩm và làm điều ác trước mắt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}?"
vi.B: Sao ông không vâng theo tiếng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}? Sao ông lại xông vào chiến lợi phẩm và làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}?"
vi.R: Sao ông không vâng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}? Sao ông lại vội vàng chiếm lấy chiến lợi phẩm? Ông đã làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} coi là ác."

ko.L: 그런데 어찌하여 너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리를 듣지 않고, 전리품에 달려들어 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 눈에 악한 일을 했느냐?"
ko.B: 그런데 어찌하여 너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리에 순종하지 않았느냐? 어찌하여 전리품에 달려들어 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 보시기에 악한 일을 했느냐?"
ko.R: 그런데 왜 너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 순종하지 않았느냐? 왜 전리품을 차지하려고 달려들었느냐? 너는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 했다."

pt.L: E por que você não ouviu a voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, mas se lançou sobre o despojo e fez o que é mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}?"
pt.B: Por que você não obedeceu à voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? Por que se atirou sobre o despojo e fez o que é mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}?"
pt.R: Por que você não obedeceu {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}? Por que correu para agarrar o despojo? Você fez o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz que é mau."

decisions.choice: swooped on the plunder: rushed greedily at it
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a bird of prey diving on its food. The people had done the same in 14:32, when they swooped on the plunder after the battle with the Philistines.

decisions.choice: did the evil in the eyes of the LORD: did what the LORD judges to be evil
decisions.reason: This is the phrase used of Israel's unfaithfulness throughout Judges (Judges 2:11). Saul has acted like the generations whose ways the kingdom was meant to change.

decisions.choice: obey; did what was evil in the sight of (Balanced) / did what the LORD said was evil (Readable)
decisions.reason: "Listen to the voice" means obey (verse 1). The Judges wording for "did the evil in the eyes of" is kept at each level. Balanced and Readable split the question into two.

source.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר שָׁא֜וּל אֶל־שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל אֲשֶׁ֤ר שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי֙ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֔ה וָאֵלֵ֕ךְ בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ אֲשֶׁר־שְׁלָחַ֣נִי יְהוָ֑ה וָאָבִ֗יא אֶת־אֲגַג֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ עֲמָלֵ֔ק וְאֶת־עֲמָלֵ֖ק הֶחֱרַֽמְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Saul to Samuel, that I listened to [the] voice of Yahweh, and I went on the way which sent me Yahweh, and I brought Agag king of Amalek, and Amalek I devoted to destruction.

en.L: And Saul said to Samuel, "But I did listen to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! And I went on the journey on which {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent me, and I brought Agag king of Amalek, and Amalek I devoted to destruction.
en.B: Saul said to Samuel, "But I did obey the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! I went on the mission {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent me on. I brought back Agag king of Amalek, and I devoted the Amalekites to destruction.
en.R: Saul said to Samuel, "But I did obey {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! I went where {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} sent me. I brought back Agag, the king of the Amalekites, and I destroyed the Amalekites completely, as given over to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y Saúl dijo a Samuel: «¡Pero sí escuché la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}! Y fui por el camino al que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me envió, y traje a Agag rey de Amalec, y a Amalec lo consagré a la destrucción.
es.B: Saúl le dijo a Samuel: «¡Pero sí obedecí la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}! Cumplí la misión que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me encargó. Traje a Agag, rey de Amalec, y consagré a la destrucción a los amalecitas.
es.R: Saúl le dijo a Samuel: «¡Pero sí obedecí {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! Fui adonde {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} me mandó. Traje a Agag, el rey de los amalecitas, y destruí por completo a los amalecitas, como pueblo entregado {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et Saül dit à Samuel : « Mais j’ai écouté la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! Et je suis allé par le chemin où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a envoyé, et j’ai ramené Agag, roi d’Amaleq, et Amaleq, je l’ai voué à l’interdit.
fr.B: Saül dit à Samuel : « Mais j’ai obéi à la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! J’ai accompli la mission que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a confiée. J’ai ramené Agag, roi d’Amaleq, et j’ai voué les Amalécites à l’interdit.
fr.R: Saül a dit à Samuel : « Mais j’ai obéi {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! Je suis allé là où {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} m’a envoyé. J’ai ramené Agag, le roi des Amalécites, et j’ai détruit complètement les Amalécites, comme une chose donnée {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na Sauli akamwambia Samweli, "Lakini mimi nimeisikiliza sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Nami nilikwenda safari ile ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinituma, nami nimemleta Agagi mfalme wa Amaleki, na Amaleki nimewaweka wakfu kwa maangamizi.
sw.B: Sauli akamwambia Samweli, "Lakini nimeitii sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Nilikwenda kwa kazi ile ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alinituma. Nimemrudisha Agagi mfalme wa Amaleki, na Waamaleki nimewaweka wakfu kwa maangamizi.
sw.R: Sauli akamwambia Samweli, "Lakini nimemtii {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Nilikwenda kule {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliponituma. Nimemrudisha Agagi, mfalme wa Waamaleki, na Waamaleki nimewaangamiza kabisa, kama watu waliotolewa kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Sau-lơ nói với Sa-mu-ên: "Nhưng tôi đã nghe theo tiếng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Tôi đã đi con đường {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sai tôi đi, tôi đã đem A-ga vua A-ma-léc về, và tôi đã tận hiến A-ma-léc cho sự hủy diệt.
vi.B: Sau-lơ nói với Sa-mu-ên: "Nhưng tôi đã vâng theo tiếng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Tôi đã đi làm sứ mạng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giao cho tôi. Tôi đã đem A-ga vua A-ma-léc về, và tôi đã tận diệt người A-ma-léc.
vi.R: Sau-lơ nói với Sa-mu-ên: "Nhưng tôi đã vâng lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Tôi đã đi đến nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} sai tôi đi. Tôi đã đem A-ga, vua người A-ma-léc, về đây, và tôi đã tiêu diệt hoàn toàn người A-ma-léc, như vật đã dâng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그러자 사울이 사무엘에게 말했다. "저는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리를 들었습니다! 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 저를 보내신 길로 갔고, 아말렉 왕 아각을 끌고 왔고, 아말렉은 진멸했습니다.
ko.B: 사울이 사무엘에게 말했다. "저는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리에 순종했습니다! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 맡기신 임무를 따라 나갔습니다. 아말렉 왕 아각을 끌고 왔고, 아말렉 사람들은 진멸했습니다.
ko.R: 사울이 사무엘에게 말했다. "저는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 순종했습니다! {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보내신 곳으로 갔습니다. 아말렉 사람들의 왕 아각을 데려왔고, 아말렉 사람들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바친 것으로 여겨 완전히 없앴습니다.

pt.L: E Saul disse a Samuel: "Mas eu ouvi a voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}! E fui pelo caminho pelo qual {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me enviou, e trouxe Agague, rei de Amaleque, e Amaleque eu consagrei à destruição.
pt.B: Saul disse a Samuel: "Mas eu obedeci à voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}! Fui na missão em que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me enviou. Trouxe Agague, rei dos amalequitas, e consagrei os amalequitas à destruição.
pt.R: Saul disse a Samuel: "Mas eu obedeci {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}! Fui aonde {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} me mandou. Trouxe Agague, o rei dos amalequitas, e destruí completamente os amalequitas, como coisa entregue {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}.

decisions.choice: but I did listen: Saul protests
decisions.reason: The small word that begins Saul's reply often introduces a protest: "but I did". Saul does not accept Samuel's charge.

decisions.choice: I brought Agag ... and Amalek I devoted: Saul sees no wrong in sparing the king
decisions.reason: Saul puts the captured king side by side with the destruction of Amalek, as if bringing Agag back alive were part of obeying. The command of verse 3 had spared no one.

decisions.choice: obey; mission (Balanced); went where the LORD sent me, destroyed ... completely (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verses 18-19. Readable explains the term as in verse 3.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֨ח הָעָ֧ם מֵהַשָּׁלָ֛ל צֹ֥אן וּבָקָ֖ר רֵאשִׁ֣ית הַחֵ֑רֶם לִזְבֹּ֛חַ לַֽיהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ בַּגִּלְגָּֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And took the people from the plunder sheep and cattle, [the] first of the devoted thing, to sacrifice to Yahweh your God in Gilgal.

en.L: And the people took from the plunder sheep and cattle, the first of the devoted things, to sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God in Gilgal."
en.B: From the plunder the troops took sheep and cattle, the choicest of what was devoted to destruction, to sacrifice to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God at Gilgal."
en.R: The soldiers took sheep and cattle from the plunder. They chose the best of the animals that belonged to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and should have been destroyed. They wanted to offer them as sacrifices to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God at Gilgal."

es.L: Y el pueblo tomó del botín ovejas y vacas, lo primero de lo consagrado a la destrucción, para sacrificar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios en Gilgal».
es.B: Del botín, la tropa tomó ovejas y vacas, lo mejor de lo que estaba consagrado a la destrucción, para ofrecerlo en sacrificio {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios en Gilgal».
es.R: Los soldados tomaron ovejas y vacas del botín. Escogieron lo mejor de los animales que le pertenecían {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y que debían haber sido destruidos. Querían ofrecerlos en sacrificio {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios en Gilgal».

fr.L: Et le peuple a pris du butin du petit et du gros bétail, les prémices de l’interdit, pour sacrifier {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu à Guilgal. »
fr.B: Dans le butin, la troupe a pris du petit et du gros bétail, le meilleur de ce qui était voué à l’interdit, pour l’offrir en sacrifice {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu à Guilgal. »
fr.R: Les soldats ont pris des moutons et des bœufs dans le butin. Ils ont choisi les meilleurs animaux, ceux qui appartenaient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et auraient dû être détruits. Ils voulaient les offrir en sacrifice {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ton Dieu à Guilgal. »

sw.L: Na watu wakachukua katika nyara kondoo na ng'ombe, walio wa kwanza katika vitu vilivyowekwa wakfu, ili kumtolea dhabihu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako huko Gilgali."
sw.B: Katika nyara, askari walichukua kondoo na ng'ombe, walio bora kabisa kati ya vile vilivyowekwa wakfu kwa maangamizi, ili wamtolee dhabihu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako huko Gilgali."
sw.R: Askari walichukua kondoo na ng'ombe katika nyara. Walichagua walio bora kati ya wanyama waliokuwa mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na waliopaswa kuangamizwa. Walitaka kuwatoa kuwa dhabihu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako huko Gilgali."

vi.L: Dân chúng đã lấy từ chiến lợi phẩm chiên và bò, phần đầu tiên của những vật đã bị tận hiến, để dâng sinh tế cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông tại Ghinh-ganh."
vi.B: Quân lính đã lấy từ chiến lợi phẩm những con chiên và bò tốt nhất trong số vật phải bị tận diệt, để dâng sinh tế cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông tại Ghinh-ganh."
vi.R: Quân lính đã lấy chiên và bò từ chiến lợi phẩm. Họ chọn những con tốt nhất trong số thú vật thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà lẽ ra phải bị tiêu diệt. Họ muốn dâng chúng làm sinh tế cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của ông tại Ghinh-ganh."

ko.L: 그리고 백성이 전리품 가운데서 진멸할 것들 가운데 첫 것인 양과 소를 가져다가 길갈에서 어른의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제사를 드리려 했습니다."
ko.B: 다만 군대가 전리품 가운데서 진멸해야 할 것들 가운데 가장 좋은 양과 소를 가져와서, 길갈에서 어른의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제물로 드리려 했습니다."
ko.R: 군인들이 전리품 가운데서 양과 소를 가져왔습니다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 속하여 없애야 했던 짐승들 가운데 가장 좋은 것을 골랐습니다. 그것들을 길갈에서 어른의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 제물로 바치려 했습니다."

pt.L: E o povo tomou do despojo ovelhas e bois, as primícias da coisa consagrada à destruição, para sacrificar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, em Gilgal."
pt.B: Do despojo, as tropas tomaram ovelhas e bois, o melhor do que tinha sido consagrado à destruição, para sacrificá-los {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, em Gilgal."
pt.R: Os soldados tomaram ovelhas e bois do despojo. Escolheram os melhores animais, que pertenciam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e deviam ter sido destruídos. Eles queriam oferecê-los como sacrifício {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o seu Deus, em Gilgal."

decisions.choice: the first of: the choicest part
decisions.reason: The word means the first or best part, the word used for the firstfruits that belong to God (Deuteronomy 18:4). Saul presents the animals as the LORD's best share.

decisions.choice: the devoted things offered as sacrifices: an offering that was not Israel's to give
decisions.reason: What is devoted already belongs wholly to the LORD and cannot be redeemed or used (Leviticus 27:28-29). The command was to destroy these animals, not to offer them. To sacrifice them is to give God what was already his while keeping the honor of the gift, and it also meant a feast for the people, since many sacrifices were eaten.

decisions.choice: the devoted thing: everything put under the ban
decisions.reason: The singular noun names the whole body of what was devoted (as in Joshua 7:1).

decisions.choice: the animals that belonged to the LORD and should have been destroyed
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the devoted things" (m2, m3) and says "They wanted to" to show the purpose.

decisions.choice: as primícias da coisa consagrada à destruição
decisions.reason: "Primícias" keeps the word of the firstfruits that belong to God (m1), and "coisa consagrada à destruição" is the book-wide noun of the ban of Joshua 6:17 in Portuguese (m3). Balanced says "o melhor", as the English says "the choicest".

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֗ל הַחֵ֤פֶץ לַֽיהוָה֙ בְּעֹל֣וֹת וּזְבָחִ֔ים כִּשְׁמֹ֖עַ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה הִנֵּ֤ה שְׁמֹ֨עַ֙ מִזֶּ֣בַח ט֔וֹב לְהַקְשִׁ֖יב מֵחֵ֥לֶב אֵילִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And said Samuel, [is there] delight to Yahweh in burnt offerings and sacrifices as in listening to [the] voice of Yahweh? Look, to listen than sacrifice [is] good, to pay attention than [the] fat of rams.

en.L: And Samuel said, "Does {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [have] delight in burnt offerings and sacrifices \q as in listening to the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? \q Look, to listen [is] better than sacrifice, \q to pay attention than the fat of rams.
en.B: Samuel said, "Is {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as pleased with burnt offerings and sacrifices \q as with obeying the voice of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}? \q See, to obey is better than sacrifice, \q and to pay heed is better than the fat of rams.
en.R: Samuel said, "Does {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} enjoy burnt offerings and sacrifices \q as much as {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} enjoys being obeyed? \q No! It is better to obey than to offer sacrifices. \q It is better to listen to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} than to offer the fat of rams.

es.L: Y Samuel dijo: «¿Se complace {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en holocaustos y sacrificios \q tanto como en que se escuche la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? \q Mira, escuchar [es] mejor que el sacrificio, \q prestar atención, que la grasa de los carneros.
es.B: Samuel dijo: «¿Le agradan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} los holocaustos y los sacrificios \q tanto como que se obedezca la voz {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}? \q Mira, obedecer es mejor que el sacrificio, \q y prestar atención es mejor que la grasa de los carneros.
es.R: Samuel dijo: «¿Le gustan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} los holocaustos y los sacrificios \q tanto como le gusta que {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} obedezcan? \q ¡No! Es mejor obedecer que ofrecer sacrificios. \q Es mejor escucharlo a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} que ofrecerle la grasa de los carneros.

fr.L: Et Samuel dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [prend-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}}] plaisir aux holocaustes et aux sacrifices \q comme à l’écoute de la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? \q Voici, écouter [vaut] mieux que le sacrifice, \q être attentif, que la graisse des béliers.
fr.B: Samuel dit : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aime-t-{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} autant les holocaustes et les sacrifices \q que l’obéissance à la voix {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ? \q Non, obéir vaut mieux que sacrifier, \q être attentif vaut mieux que la graisse des béliers.
fr.R: Samuel a dit : « Est-ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aime les sacrifices complets par le feu et les autres sacrifices \q autant qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aime qu’on {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} obéisse ? \q Non ! Il vaut mieux obéir que d’offrir des sacrifices. \q Il vaut mieux {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}écouter que d’offrir la graisse des béliers.

sw.L: Na Samweli akasema, "Je, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [anapendezwa] na sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu \q kama kwa kuisikiliza sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? \q Tazama, kusikiliza [ni] bora kuliko dhabihu, \q kusikia kwa makini kuliko mafuta ya kondoo dume.
sw.B: Samweli akasema, "Je, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hupendezwa na sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu \q kama anavyopendezwa na kuitii sauti ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}? \q Tazama, kutii ni bora kuliko dhabihu, \q na kusikiliza ni bora kuliko mafuta ya kondoo dume.
sw.R: Samweli akasema, "Je, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hufurahia sadaka za kuteketezwa na dhabihu \q kama anavyofurahi watu wanapomtii? \q Hapana! Ni bora kutii kuliko kutoa dhabihu. \q Ni bora kumsikiliza kuliko kutoa mafuta ya kondoo dume.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có vui thích tế lễ thiêu và sinh tế \q bằng sự nghe theo tiếng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chăng? \q Kìa, sự nghe theo tốt hơn sinh tế, \q sự lắng nghe [tốt hơn] mỡ chiên đực.
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có hài lòng về tế lễ thiêu và sinh tế \q bằng sự vâng theo tiếng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} không? \q Này, vâng lời tốt hơn dâng sinh tế, \q và lắng nghe tốt hơn mỡ chiên đực.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên nói: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} có ưa thích tế lễ thiêu và sinh tế \q bằng khi người ta vâng lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không? \q Không! Vâng lời tốt hơn dâng sinh tế. \q Lắng nghe {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tốt hơn dâng mỡ chiên đực.

ko.L: 그러자 사무엘이 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 번제와 제사를 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리를 듣는 것만큼 기뻐하시겠느냐? \q 보아라, 듣는 것이 제사보다 낫고, \q 귀 기울이는 것이 숫양의 기름보다 [낫다].
ko.B: 사무엘이 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 번제와 제사를 \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 목소리에 순종하는 것만큼 기뻐하시겠느냐? \q 보아라, 순종하는 것이 제사보다 낫고, \q 귀 기울이는 것이 숫양의 기름보다 낫다.
ko.R: 사무엘이 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 번제물과 제물을 \q 순종하는 것만큼 기뻐하시겠느냐? \q 아니다! 순종하는 것이 제물을 바치는 것보다 낫다. \q 그분의 말씀을 듣는 것이 숫양의 기름을 바치는 것보다 낫다.

pt.L: E Samuel disse: "Tem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} prazer em holocaustos e sacrifícios \q como em que se escute a voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? \q Eis que escutar [é] melhor do que sacrifício, \q prestar atenção, do que a gordura de carneiros.
pt.B: Samuel disse: "Será que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se agrada tanto de holocaustos e sacrifícios \q quanto de que obedeçam à voz {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}? \q Veja: obedecer é melhor do que sacrificar, \q e escutar com atenção vale mais do que a gordura dos carneiros.
pt.R: Samuel disse: "Será que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} gosta tanto de holocaustos e sacrifícios \q quanto {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} gosta de ser obedecido? \q Não! Obedecer é melhor do que oferecer sacrifícios. \q Escutar o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} diz vale mais do que oferecer a gordura dos carneiros.

decisions.choice: does the LORD delight ... as in listening: a question that expects "no"
decisions.reason: The question is not about whether sacrifice pleases God at all; it compares two things. Obeying his voice pleases him more, as the second half of the verse says outright.

decisions.choice: burnt offerings, sacrifices, the fat of rams
decisions.reason: A burnt offering was burned whole on the altar; other sacrifices were shared in a meal, with the fat burned for the LORD as his portion (Leviticus 3:9-11, 16). "The fat of rams" is the best part of the best animals.

decisions.choice: to listen is better than sacrifice: worship cannot stand in for obedience
decisions.reason: Samuel does not reject the sacrifices the Law commands. He says that offerings made instead of obedience do not please God. The prophets say the same again and again (Hosea 6:6; Amos 5:21-24; Isaiah 1:11-17; Jeremiah 7:21-23; Psalm 40:7-9).

decisions.choice: to pay attention: to listen closely and heed
decisions.reason: The verb, used beside "listen", means to turn the ear and take notice; it repeats the first half of the saying in other words.

decisions.choice: Samuel's reply is poetry
decisions.reason: Samuel's answer (verses 22-23) is set in balanced pairs of lines, as prophets' sayings often are.

decisions.choice: obeying / to obey (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "Listen to the voice" means obey (verse 1), so Balanced and Readable say "obey". Literal keeps "listen" to show the play on "voice" and "sound" in verses 14, 19 and 24.

decisions.choice: No!
decisions.reason: Readable answers the question, as the second half of the verse does (m1), in place of "look".

decisions.choice: Samuel's answer set in lines at every level, as the English
decisions.reason: The reply is poetry in the Hebrew (m5); French follows the English line breaks.

decisions.choice: Samuel's answer set in lines (verses 22-23)
decisions.reason: As the English, Samuel's reply is poetry (m5), so every level is set in lines, following the Hebrew's division.

decisions.choice: lines set as poetry
decisions.reason: Samuel's answer is poetry (m5), set in lines at every level as the English is; the Hebrew's two-line pairs set the breaks. "He" and "him" for God sit inside the verbs at Readable, so the English spans have no Swahili counterpart here.

decisions.choice: Samuel's answer set in lines at every level, as the English
decisions.reason: Samuel's reply is poetry (meaning decision); the Samuel terms note sets lines wherever the English has them, with Vietnamese breaks at the same Hebrew divisions.

decisions.choice: Samuel's reply set in four lines, as the English, each line closed in Korean
decisions.reason: The English sets verses 22-23 in lines (m5); Korean keeps the same four lines, putting the shared verb "기뻐하시겠느냐" at the end of the second line, where Korean needs it.

decisions.choice: escutar [é] melhor do que sacrifício (L); obedecer é melhor do que sacrificar (B, R); prestar atenção (L), escutar com atenção (B)
decisions.reason: Drafted from the Hebrew and the gloss. Literal says "escutar", so that the play on "voz" and "som" of verses 14, 19 and 24 stays visible, as the English Literal keeps "listen"; Balanced and Readable say "obedecer", the sense of listening to the LORD's voice (verse 1). The second line puts the rare verb of m4 in its own words, "escutar com atenção", rather than a single verb.

source.text: כִּ֤י חַטַּאת־קֶ֨סֶם֙ מֶ֔רִי וְאָ֥וֶן וּתְרָפִ֖ים הַפְצַ֑ר יַ֗עַן מָאַ֨סְתָּ֙ אֶת־דְּבַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה וַיִּמְאָסְךָ֖ מִמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: For [the] sin of divination [is] rebellion, and iniquity and teraphim [is] presumption. Because you rejected [the] word of Yahweh, and he rejected you from king.

en.L: For rebellion [is] the sin of divination, \q and presumption [is] iniquity and household gods. \q Because you have rejected the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has rejected you from [being] king."
en.B: For rebellion is as sinful as divination, \q and arrogance is like wickedness and household gods. \q You have rejected the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has rejected you as king."
en.R: Refusing to obey is as sinful as trying to learn the future by magic. \q Being proud and stubborn is as evil as worshiping household idols. \q You have rejected what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} told you, \q so {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has rejected you as king."

es.L: Porque la rebelión [es] pecado de adivinación, \q y la presunción [es] iniquidad e ídolos domésticos. \q Por cuanto has rechazado la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te ha rechazado para que no [seas] rey».
es.B: Porque la rebelión es tan pecaminosa como la adivinación, \q y la arrogancia es como la maldad y el ídolo doméstico. \q Tú has rechazado la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, \q y por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te ha rechazado como rey».
es.R: Negarse a obedecer es tan malo como querer conocer el futuro por medio de la magia. \q Ser orgulloso y terco es tan malo como adorar ídolos domésticos. \q Has rechazado lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} te dijo, \q y por eso {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te ha rechazado como rey».

fr.L: Car la rébellion [est] le péché de divination, \q et l’obstination, la faute et les dieux domestiques. \q Parce que tu as rejeté la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a rejeté [pour que tu ne sois plus] roi. »
fr.B: Car la rébellion est aussi coupable que la divination, \q et l’obstination aussi grave que le crime et les dieux domestiques. \q Tu as rejeté la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, \q alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a rejeté comme roi. »
fr.R: Refuser d’obéir est aussi grave que chercher à connaître l’avenir par la magie. \q Être orgueilleux et têtu est aussi mal qu’adorer des idoles domestiques. \q Tu as rejeté ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} t’avait dit, \q alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’a rejeté : tu ne seras plus roi. »

sw.L: Kwa maana uasi [ni] dhambi ya uaguzi, \q na ukaidi [ni] uovu na miungu ya nyumbani. \q Kwa sababu umelikataa neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q naye amekukataa [usiwe] mfalme."
sw.B: Kwa maana uasi ni dhambi kama uaguzi, \q na kiburi ni kama uovu na sanamu za miungu ya nyumbani. \q Umelikataa neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q kwa hiyo naye amekukataa usiwe mfalme."
sw.R: Kukataa kutii ni dhambi kama kujaribu kujua mambo yajayo kwa uchawi. \q Kiburi na ukaidi ni uovu kama kuabudu sanamu za miungu ya nyumbani. \q Umekataa yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyokuambia, \q kwa hiyo naye amekukataa usiwe mfalme."

vi.L: Vì sự phản nghịch [là] tội bói toán, \q và sự ngạo mạn [là] tội ác và các tượng thần gia đình. \q Vì ông đã từ bỏ lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã từ bỏ ông, không cho [làm] vua nữa."
vi.B: Vì sự phản nghịch cũng tội lỗi như bói toán, \q và sự ngạo mạn cũng như tội ác và thờ các tượng thần gia đình. \q Ông đã từ bỏ lời của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, \q nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã từ bỏ ông, không cho làm vua nữa."
vi.R: Không vâng lời là tội nặng như dùng bùa phép để đoán tương lai. \q Kiêu ngạo và cứng đầu cũng ác như thờ tượng thần nhỏ của gia đình. \q Ông đã từ bỏ điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} truyền cho ông, \q nên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã từ bỏ ông, không cho ông làm vua nữa."

ko.L: 거역은 점치는 죄요, \q 고집은 죄악과 드라빔이다. \q 네가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 버렸으므로, \q 그분께서도 너를 버려 왕이 [되지] 못하게 하셨다."
ko.B: 거역하는 것은 점치는 것만큼 죄가 되고, \q 고집을 부리는 것은 죄악과 집안 우상을 섬기는 것과 같다. \q 네가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 버렸으니, \q 그분께서도 너를 버려 왕이 되지 못하게 하셨다."
ko.R: 순종하지 않는 것은 마술로 앞일을 알아내려는 것만큼 큰 죄다. \q 교만하고 고집을 부리는 것은 집안 우상을 섬기는 것만큼 악하다. \q 네가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀을 버렸으니, \q 그분께서도 너를 버려 더 이상 왕이 되지 못하게 하셨다."

pt.L: Pois a rebelião [é] o pecado de adivinhação, \q e a presunção [é] iniquidade e terafins. \q Porque você rejeitou a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} rejeitou você de [ser] rei."
pt.B: Pois a rebelião é como o pecado de adivinhação, \q e a arrogância é como a maldade e os ídolos do lar. \q Você rejeitou a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, \q por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} rejeitou você como rei."
pt.R: Recusar-se a obedecer é tão grave como tentar descobrir o futuro com magia. \q Ser orgulhoso e teimoso é tão mau como adorar ídolos do lar. \q Você rejeitou o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe disse, \q por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} rejeitou você como rei."

decisions.choice: rebellion is the sin of divination: rebellion is as bad as divination
decisions.reason: The lines set two things side by side with no verb. They do not say that rebellion is the same act as divination, but that it is just as serious a sin before God.

decisions.choice: divination: seeking hidden knowledge by omens and signs
decisions.reason: Divination was forbidden in Israel (Deuteronomy 18:10-14). Later Saul himself will seek a medium to call up Samuel (28:7-8).

decisions.choice: iniquity and household gods: wickedness linked with idols
decisions.reason: The first word means wrongdoing, and it is often used of idol worship (Hosea 10:8). Teraphim were small images of household gods (Genesis 31:19; 1 Samuel 19:13). The pair names idolatry.

decisions.choice: presumption: pushing ahead with one's own will
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb meaning to press or urge (Genesis 19:3; 33:11). It describes insisting on one's own way against what God has said.

decisions.choice: you have rejected ... he has rejected you: the sentence matches the deed
decisions.reason: The same verb is used twice. Saul refused the LORD's word, and the LORD refuses Saul as king. Verse 26 repeats it.

decisions.choice: as sinful as; arrogance is like (Balanced); as evil as (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the comparison the lines imply (m1). Balanced says "arrogance" and Readable "being proud and stubborn" for the rare word (m4). Balanced joins the last two lines with "so" in place of "because", which says the same thing.

decisions.choice: trying to learn the future by magic; worshiping household idols
decisions.reason: Readable explains "divination" and uses the book-wide Readable wording for teraphim, "household idols".

decisions.choice: "les dieux domestiques" (Literal, Balanced); "des idoles domestiques" (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note settles for the teraphim, following the English "household gods" and "household idols".

decisions.choice: "ídolos domésticos" (L); "el ídolo doméstico" (B); "ídolos domésticos" (R)
decisions.reason: For 1 and 2 Samuel, as the Samuel terms note gives the teraphim ("los dioses domésticos" at L, "el ídolo doméstico" at B and R). Here the word stands beside "iniquity" as a kind of sin, so Literal says "ídolos" rather than "dioses", and Readable keeps the plural for the practice of worshiping them.

decisions.choice: miungu ya nyumbani (L); sanamu za miungu ya nyumbani (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note: the teraphim are "miungu ya nyumbani" at Literal and "sanamu za miungu ya nyumbani" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "các tượng thần gia đình" (L, B); "tượng thần nhỏ của gia đình" (R) for *teraphim*
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for household gods.

decisions.choice: "드라빔" (L); "집안 우상" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note for the household gods (teraphim). Used for the whole block.

decisions.choice: a adivinhação; os terafins (L), os ídolos do lar (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Adivinhação" names the search for hidden knowledge by omens (m2), which Readable explains. The teraphim keep the book-wide wording, "terafins" at Literal and "ídolos do lar" at Balanced and Readable, as Genesis 31 and Judges 17-18 in Portuguese.
