records.literal_gloss: And said Saul to Samuel, I have sinned, for I transgressed [the] mouth of Yahweh and your words, because I feared the people and listened to their voice.

en.L: And Saul said to Samuel, "I have sinned, for I have transgressed the mouth of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and your words, because I feared the people and listened to their voice.
en.B: Then Saul said to Samuel, "I have sinned. I have broken the command of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and your instructions, because I was afraid of the troops and gave in to what they said.
en.R: Then Saul said to Samuel, "I have sinned. I did not keep the command of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} or follow your instructions. I was afraid of my soldiers, so I did what they wanted.

es.L: Y Saúl dijo a Samuel: «He pecado, porque he traspasado la boca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y tus palabras, porque temí al pueblo y escuché su voz.
es.B: Entonces Saúl le dijo a Samuel: «He pecado. He quebrantado el mandato {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y tus instrucciones, porque tuve miedo de la tropa y cedí a lo que me pedían.
es.R: Entonces Saúl le dijo a Samuel: «He pecado. No cumplí la orden {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} ni seguí tus instrucciones. Tuve miedo de mis soldados, así que hice lo que ellos querían.

fr.L: Et Saül dit à Samuel : « J’ai péché, car j’ai transgressé la bouche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et tes paroles, parce que j’ai craint le peuple et j’ai écouté sa voix.
fr.B: Saül dit alors à Samuel : « J’ai péché. J’ai transgressé l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et tes instructions, parce que j’ai eu peur de la troupe et que j’ai cédé à ce qu’elle disait.
fr.R: Alors Saül a dit à Samuel : « J’ai péché. Je n’ai pas respecté l’ordre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, ni suivi tes instructions. J’ai eu peur de mes soldats, alors j’ai fait ce qu’ils voulaient.

sw.L: Na Sauli akamwambia Samweli, "Nimetenda dhambi, kwa maana nimekiasi kinywa cha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na maneno yako, kwa sababu niliwaogopa watu nikaisikiliza sauti yao.
sw.B: Ndipo Sauli akamwambia Samweli, "Nimetenda dhambi. Nimevunja amri ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na maagizo yako, kwa sababu niliwaogopa askari nikakubali walichosema.
sw.R: Ndipo Sauli akamwambia Samweli, "Nimetenda dhambi. Sikushika amri ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wala sikufuata maagizo yako. Niliwaogopa askari wangu, kwa hiyo nikafanya walichotaka.

vi.L: Sau-lơ nói với Sa-mu-ên: "Tôi đã phạm tội, vì tôi đã vi phạm miệng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và lời ông, vì tôi sợ dân chúng và đã nghe theo tiếng họ.
vi.B: Bấy giờ Sau-lơ nói với Sa-mu-ên: "Tôi đã phạm tội. Tôi đã vi phạm mệnh lệnh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và lời dặn của ông, vì tôi sợ quân lính và đã chiều theo ý họ.
vi.R: Bấy giờ Sau-lơ nói với Sa-mu-ên: "Tôi đã phạm tội. Tôi đã không giữ mệnh lệnh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và không làm theo lời ông dặn. Tôi sợ quân lính của tôi, nên đã làm theo điều họ muốn.

ko.L: 그러자 사울이 사무엘에게 말했다. "제가 죄를 지었습니다. 제가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 입과 어른의 말씀을 어겼습니다. 제가 백성을 두려워하여 그들의 목소리를 들었기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 그러자 사울이 사무엘에게 말했다. "제가 죄를 지었습니다. 제가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령과 어른의 말씀을 어겼습니다. 군대가 두려워서 그들의 말을 들어주었습니다.
ko.R: 그러자 사울이 사무엘에게 말했다. "제가 죄를 지었습니다. 저는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 명령을 지키지 않았고, 어른의 말씀도 따르지 않았습니다. 군인들이 두려워서 그들이 원하는 대로 했습니다.

pt.L: E Saul disse a Samuel: "Pequei, porque transgredi a boca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e as suas palavras, porque temi o povo e ouvi a sua voz.
pt.B: Então Saul disse a Samuel: "Pequei. Desobedeci à ordem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e às instruções do senhor, porque tive medo das tropas e cedi ao que elas diziam.
pt.R: Então Saul disse a Samuel: "Pequei. Não cumpri a ordem {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} nem segui as instruções do senhor. Tive medo dos meus soldados e por isso fiz o que eles queriam.

decisions.choice: transgressed the mouth of the LORD: broke the LORD's command
decisions.reason: "Mouth" stands for what was spoken, a command. To "pass over" it is to go beyond it, to break it.

decisions.choice: listened to their voice: obeyed the people
decisions.reason: Saul now admits that he listened to the wrong voice. The chapter set listening to the voice of the LORD (verses 1, 19, 20, 22) against this.

decisions.choice: I have sinned ... because I feared the people: a confession with an excuse
decisions.reason: Saul confesses, but he also gives a reason that shifts part of the blame, as in verse 15. The king, who is "head of the tribes" (verse 17), says he gave way to fear of his own troops.

decisions.choice: the troops / my soldiers; gave in to what they said / did what they wanted
decisions.reason: "The people" are the army (verse 4). Balanced and Readable give the sense of "listened to their voice" (m2); Literal keeps the word "voice".

source.text: וְעַתָּ֕ה שָׂ֥א נָ֖א אֶת־חַטָּאתִ֑י וְשׁ֣וּב עִמִּ֔י וְאֶֽשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And now, forgive please my sin, and return with me, and I will bow down to Yahweh.

en.L: And now, please forgive my sin, and return with me, that I may bow down to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: Now please forgive my sin, and come back with me so that I may worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: Now please forgive my sin. Come back with me so that I can worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

es.L: Y ahora, te ruego, perdona mi pecado, y vuelve conmigo, para que me postre ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.B: Ahora, por favor, perdona mi pecado y vuelve conmigo para que pueda adorar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}».
es.R: Ahora, por favor, perdona mi pecado. Vuelve conmigo para que pueda adorar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et maintenant, pardonne donc mon péché, et reviens avec moi, et je me prosternerai devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: Maintenant, je t’en prie, pardonne mon péché et reviens avec moi, pour que j’adore {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Maintenant, s’il te plaît, pardonne mon péché. Reviens avec moi pour que je puisse adorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »

sw.L: Na sasa, tafadhali nisamehe dhambi yangu, urudi pamoja nami, nipate kumsujudia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Sasa tafadhali nisamehe dhambi yangu, urudi pamoja nami ili nimwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Sasa tafadhali nisamehe dhambi yangu. Rudi pamoja nami ili niweze kumwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, xin tha tội cho tôi, và trở về với tôi, để tôi thờ lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.B: Bây giờ xin ông tha tội cho tôi và trở về với tôi để tôi thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."
vi.R: Bây giờ xin ông tha tội cho tôi. Xin trở về với tôi để tôi thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}."

ko.L: 그러니 이제 제발 제 죄를 용서해 주시고, 저와 함께 돌아가 주십시오. 제가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 경배하겠습니다."
ko.B: 그러니 이제 제 죄를 용서해 주십시오. 저와 함께 돌아가셔서 제가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 경배하게 해 주십시오."
ko.R: 이제 제발 제 죄를 용서해 주십시오. 저와 함께 돌아가 주십시오. 그래야 제가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 예배할 수 있습니다."

pt.L: E agora, perdoe, por favor, o meu pecado, e volte comigo, para que eu me prostre diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}."
pt.B: Agora, por favor, perdoe o meu pecado e volte comigo, para que eu adore {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."
pt.R: Agora, por favor, perdoe o meu pecado. Volte comigo para que eu possa adorar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}."

decisions.choice: forgive: bear away, pardon
decisions.reason: The verb means to lift up or carry; with "sin" it means to take it away, to pardon. Saul asks Samuel to pardon him, or to stand with him so that he is seen as pardoned.

decisions.choice: bow down: worship
decisions.reason: The verb means to bow low to the ground, the bodily act of worship.

decisions.choice: return with me: come back and worship with me in public
decisions.reason: Saul wants the prophet beside him when he worships at Gilgal, where the people and the elders can see it (verse 30).

decisions.choice: worship
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "worship" for the act of bowing down (m2); Literal keeps "bow down".

decisions.choice: you have rejected ... the LORD has rejected you: Samuel repeats the sentence of verse 23
decisions.reason: Samuel restates the verdict in plain words: the rejection matches the deed. Saul's request does not change it.

decisions.choice: from being king: so that you are no longer king
decisions.reason: The words say what Saul is rejected from. The sentence is on his reign as the LORD's king; he will still hold the throne for years, but the LORD no longer stands behind his kingship (16:1, 14).

decisions.choice: So the LORD has rejected you. You will no longer be king over Israel.
decisions.reason: Readable breaks the sentence into short ones and states what "rejected you from being king" means (m2).

decisions.choice: he seized: Saul took hold of Samuel's robe
alternatives: Samuel took hold of the hem of Saul's robe
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not name the one who seized the robe. The setting shows that it was Saul, holding Samuel back as he turned to go, and the ancient Greek translation names Saul here. Some have read it as Samuel tearing Saul's robe as a sign, but verse 28 reads best as Samuel explaining what had just happened to his own robe.

decisions.choice: the hem of his robe: the edge of the prophet's cloak
decisions.reason: The robe was an outer garment of some standing; Samuel wore one from childhood (2:19), and Saul will know him by it (28:14). Grasping a person's hem was a gesture of pleading. Later David will cut off the hem of Saul's robe (24:5).

decisions.choice: Saul (Balanced, Readable); Samuel's robe (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Saul as the one who took hold of the robe (m1); Readable also names Samuel as its owner. Literal keeps the Hebrew "he" and "his".

decisions.choice: has torn: the torn robe is a sign
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used of the robe in verse 27. What happened to Samuel's robe pictures what the LORD has done to Saul's kingdom. The prophet Ahijah will tear a robe as a sign of a divided kingdom in 1 Kings 11:29-31.

decisions.choice: has given it: the decision is made, though not yet seen
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form for a finished act. The new king has not yet been anointed (16:1-13), but in the LORD's purpose the kingdom already belongs to him.

decisions.choice: your neighbor, better than you: another Israelite, not yet named
decisions.reason: The word means a neighbor or fellow, someone of Saul's own people. It is David (16:13), and 28:17 repeats these words with his name.

decisions.choice: another man
decisions.reason: Readable says "another man" for "your neighbor", which here means a fellow Israelite (m3), not someone living next door.

decisions.choice: "ha rasgado" (L); "te ha arrancado" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the verb of verse 27, "rasgar", so that the torn robe can be seen as the sign (m1); Balanced and Readable say "arrancar", the natural verb for taking a kingdom away.

decisions.choice: ameurarua
decisions.reason: The torn robe is a sign (m1), so Swahili keeps the same verb, "kurarua", for the robe (verse 27) and the kingdom at every level.

decisions.choice: rasgou (L); arrancou (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "rasgar", the verb of the torn robe in verse 27, so the sign can be seen (m1); Balanced and Readable say "arrancar", the Portuguese verb for tearing a thing away from someone, which still keeps the picture of tearing.

en.R: Besides, God, the Glory of Israel, does not lie or change {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} mind. He is not a human being, who might change course."

decisions.choice: the Glory of Israel: a title of God
decisions.reason: The title is found only here. The noun can mean splendor, lasting strength, victory or endurance (it is used for "forever" in many places). Each sense fits a God whose word stands.

decisions.choice: he will not regret: God does not go back on his sentence, as a human might
alternatives: the two statements contradict each other
decisions.reason: This is the same verb as "I regret" in verse 11 and "the LORD regretted" in verse 35, and the words echo Balaam's in Numbers 23:19. The chapter holds both statements within a few verses. In verses 11 and 35 the word speaks of God's real grief at Saul's disobedience and of his turning from the course he had begun with Saul. Here Samuel denies that God changes his mind the way people do: by being fickle, by being deceived, or by being talked out of a decision. Saul has just pleaded to be restored (verses 25, 30); Samuel's answer is that the sentence of verse 28 will not be undone. So God's "regret" is his true response to what people do, not a sign of weakness or ignorance; and his word, once spoken in judgment, stands (compare Jeremiah 18:7-10, where God says he relents when people turn, and Exodus 32:14).

decisions.choice: not a man that he should regret: humans change their minds; God is not like them
decisions.reason: The line compares God with people. A human ruler might reverse a decree when begged; God's word does not bend that way.

decisions.choice: and also: Samuel adds a further reason
decisions.reason: The words add to verse 28: not only has the LORD torn the kingdom away; he will not take the sentence back.

decisions.choice: regret (Literal); change his mind (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "regret" here as in verses 11 and 35, so the reader can see that one verb is used three times. Balanced and Readable say "change his mind", the sense this verse denies (m2), while keeping "regret" and "was sorry" in verses 11 and 35.

decisions.choice: God, the Glory of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable names God, so that the unusual title is clearly a title of the LORD (m1).

decisions.choice: {{gender:un être humain|un homme}}
decisions.reason: As the English: the point is that God is not like a human being; the noun takes the setting at Literal, and Balanced and Readable say "un mortel", "un être humain", already inclusive.

decisions.choice: mwanadamu (L, B); binadamu (R), no gender span
alternatives: a span like the English Literal one
decisions.reason: "Mwanadamu" already means a human being, man or woman, so the English Literal span has no second Swahili wording. The free pronouns "yeye" and "yake" for God take the deity pronoun span.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "loài người"
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "loài người" already means a human being of either sex, so there is only one natural wording (Vietnamese style guide, section 7).

decisions.choice: "Đấng Vinh Quang của Y-sơ-ra-ên"
decisions.reason: A title of God (meaning decision); "Đấng" marks it as a person.

decisions.choice: "사람" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "사람" means a human being, which is the sense here; there is only one natural wording, as 2:25.

decisions.choice: "후회하지 않으신다" (L); "마음을 바꾸지 않으신다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The same verb as verses 11 and 35 (m2); Literal keeps "후회하다" so the link is seen, and Balanced and Readable say "change his mind", as the English does.

decisions.choice: a Glória de Israel não mente
decisions.reason: The title (m1) is "a Glória de Israel", with a capital, at every level, as in the English; "não mente" is the plain present of a God whose word stands.

decisions.choice: muda de ideia (no possessive)
decisions.reason: Portuguese "mudar de ideia" needs no possessive, so Balanced has no span where the English "his mind" has one; the pronoun "ele" keeps its span. Literal keeps "arrepender-se", as in verses 11 and 35.

records.literal_gloss: And he said, I have sinned; now honor me please before [the] elders of my people and before Israel, and return with me, and I will bow down to Yahweh your God.

en.L: And he said, "I have sinned. Now honor me, please, before the elders of my people and before Israel, and return with me, and I will bow down to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God."
en.B: Saul said, "I have sinned. But please honor me now in front of the elders of my people and in front of Israel. Return with me, and let me worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God."

es.L: Y él dijo: «He pecado. Ahora, te ruego, hónrame delante de los ancianos de mi pueblo y delante de Israel, y vuelve conmigo, y me postraré ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} tu Dios».
es.B: Saúl dijo: «He pecado. Pero, por favor, hónrame ahora delante de los ancianos de mi pueblo y delante de Israel. Vuelve conmigo, y déjame adorar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios».
es.R: Saúl dijo: «He pecado. Pero, por favor, muéstrame respeto delante de los líderes de mi pueblo y delante del pueblo de Israel. Vuelve conmigo para que pueda adorar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} tu Dios».

fr.L: Et il dit : « J’ai péché. Maintenant, honore-moi donc devant les anciens de mon peuple et devant Israël, et reviens avec moi, et je me prosternerai devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. »

fr.R: Saül a dit : « J’ai péché. Mais s’il te plaît, montre-moi du respect devant les responsables de mon peuple et devant le peuple d’Israël. Reviens avec moi pour que je puisse adorer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ton Dieu. »

sw.L: Naye akasema, "Nimetenda dhambi. Sasa tafadhali uniheshimu mbele ya wazee wa watu wangu na mbele ya Israeli, urudi pamoja nami, nami nitamsujudia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako."
sw.B: Sauli akasema, "Nimetenda dhambi. Lakini tafadhali uniheshimu sasa mbele ya wazee wa watu wangu na mbele ya Israeli. Rudi pamoja nami, niruhusu nimwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako."
sw.R: Sauli akasema, "Nimetenda dhambi. Lakini tafadhali unionyeshe heshima mbele ya viongozi wa watu wangu na mbele ya watu wa Israeli. Rudi pamoja nami ili niweze kumwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wako."

ko.B: 사울이 말했다. "제가 죄를 지었습니다. 그러나 제 백성의 장로들과 이스라엘 앞에서 제 체면을 세워 주십시오. 저와 함께 돌아가셔서, 제가 어른의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 경배하게 해 주십시오."

decisions.choice: I have sinned; now honor me: a confession followed by a request for honor
decisions.reason: Saul repeats his confession, but what he asks for now is honor before the people. His concern is how he will be seen.

decisions.choice: the LORD your God
decisions.reason: As in verses 15 and 21, Saul calls the LORD Samuel's God.

decisions.choice: Saul said; leaders (Readable); worship
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Saul as the speaker. Readable says "leaders" for "elders", the older men who led the tribes, and "the people of Israel"; Balanced and Readable say "worship" (verse 25).

decisions.choice: Samuel went back: the sentence still stands
decisions.reason: Samuel had refused to go back (verse 26), and now he does. He grants Saul honor before the people, but nothing in the verdict changes. He also has a duty of his own still to carry out: the sentence on Agag (verses 32-33).

decisions.choice: went back with; worshiped
decisions.reason: "Returned after Saul" means he followed Saul back. Balanced and Readable say "worshiped" for "bowed down" (verse 25).

en.L: And Samuel said, "Bring near to me Agag king of Amalek." And Agag came to him confidently. And Agag said, "Surely the bitterness of death has turned aside."
en.B: Then Samuel said, "Bring Agag king of Amalek here to me." Agag came to him confidently, and Agag said, "Surely the bitterness of death is past."
en.R: Then Samuel said, "Bring me Agag, the king of the Amalekites." Agag came to him full of hope. He said, "Surely the bitter threat of death is over for me now."

es.L: Y Samuel dijo: «{{plural_you:Tráiganme|Traedme}} a Agag rey de Amalec». Y Agag vino a él confiado. Y Agag dijo: «Ciertamente ha pasado la amargura de la muerte».
es.B: Luego Samuel dijo: «{{plural_you:Tráiganme|Traedme}} aquí a Agag, rey de Amalec». Agag se le acercó confiado, y dijo: «Sin duda ya pasó la amargura de la muerte».
es.R: Luego Samuel dijo: «{{plural_you:Tráiganme|Traedme}} a Agag, el rey de los amalecitas». Agag se le acercó lleno de esperanza. Dijo: «Seguro que ya pasó para mí la amarga amenaza de la muerte».

fr.L: Et Samuel dit : « Amenez-moi Agag, roi d’Amaleq. » Et Agag vint vers lui avec assurance. Et Agag dit : « Certainement, l’amertume de la mort s’est éloignée. »
fr.B: Puis Samuel dit : « Amenez-moi Agag, roi d’Amaleq. » Agag s’avança vers lui avec assurance et dit : « Sûrement, l’amertume de la mort est passée. »
fr.R: Ensuite, Samuel a dit : « Amenez-moi Agag, le roi des Amalécites. » Agag est venu vers lui plein d’espoir. Il a dit : « Maintenant, je ne risque sûrement plus la mort. »

sw.L: Na Samweli akasema, "Nileteeni karibu Agagi mfalme wa Amaleki." Na Agagi akamwendea kwa kujiamini. Na Agagi akasema, "Hakika uchungu wa kifo umeondoka."
sw.B: Kisha Samweli akasema, "Nileteeni hapa Agagi mfalme wa Amaleki." Agagi akamwendea kwa kujiamini, akasema, "Hakika uchungu wa kifo umepita."
sw.R: Kisha Samweli akasema, "Nileteeni Agagi, mfalme wa Waamaleki." Agagi akamjia akiwa amejaa matumaini. Akasema, "Hakika hatari chungu ya kifo imeniondokea sasa."

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nói: "Hãy đem A-ga vua A-ma-léc đến gần ta." A-ga đến với người cách tự tin. A-ga nói: "Chắc hẳn nỗi cay đắng của sự chết đã qua rồi."
vi.B: Bấy giờ Sa-mu-ên nói: "Hãy đem A-ga vua A-ma-léc đến đây cho ta." A-ga đến với người cách tự tin, và A-ga nói: "Chắc hẳn nỗi cay đắng của cái chết đã qua rồi."
vi.R: Bấy giờ Sa-mu-ên nói: "Hãy đem A-ga, vua người A-ma-léc, đến cho ta." A-ga đến với người, đầy hy vọng. Hắn nói: "Chắc hẳn bây giờ ta đã thoát khỏi mối đe dọa cay đắng của cái chết rồi."

ko.L: 그리고 사무엘이 말했다. "아말렉 왕 아각을 내게로 끌어오너라." 그러자 아각이 태연하게 그에게 왔다. 그리고 아각이 말했다. "죽음의 쓴 고비가 정녕 지나갔구나."
ko.B: 그때 사무엘이 말했다. "아말렉 왕 아각을 내게 끌고 오너라." 아각은 마음을 놓고 그에게 나아왔다. 아각이 말했다. "이제 죽음의 쓴맛은 지나갔겠지."
ko.R: 그때 사무엘이 말했다. "아말렉 사람들의 왕 아각을 내게 데려오너라." 아각은 희망에 차서 사무엘에게 왔다. 그가 말했다. "이제 죽을 걱정은 다 끝났구나."

pt.L: E Samuel disse: "Tragam para perto de mim Agague, rei de Amaleque." E Agague veio até ele confiante. E Agague disse: "Certamente a amargura da morte se afastou."
pt.B: Então Samuel disse: "Tragam aqui para mim Agague, rei dos amalequitas." Agague veio até ele confiante e disse: "Com certeza a amargura da morte já passou."
pt.R: Então Samuel disse: "Tragam-me Agague, o rei dos amalequitas." Agague veio até ele cheio de esperança. Ele disse: "Com certeza a ameaça amarga da morte já passou para mim."

decisions.choice: confidently: at ease, expecting to be spared
decisions.reason: The word is rare. Taken from a root meaning "delight", it means cheerfully or at ease, and fits Agag's words that follow. With the letters read in a slightly different order, it means "in bonds" (compare Job 38:31), and some take it as "trembling" or "reluctantly".

decisions.choice: surely the bitterness of death has passed: Agag thinks he is safe
decisions.reason: Read this way, Agag believes that since he has been kept alive so far, he will not now be killed. The ancient Greek translation has a different sense, "Is death as bitter as this?", and some read the Hebrew as "Surely death is bitter", Agag's lament as he comes to die.

decisions.choice: full of hope; the bitter threat of death is over for me now
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain what Agag's confidence and words mean (m1, m2).

decisions.choice: Samuel says "ta" to the soldiers and to Agag, and Agag "ta" of himself
decisions.reason: Samuel gives orders as judge, and the captive king still speaks as a king; Samuel says "tôi" only to Saul and the people of Israel.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁמוּאֵ֔ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר שִׁכְּלָ֤ה נָשִׁים֙ חַרְבֶּ֔ךָ כֵּן־תִּשְׁכַּ֥ל מִנָּשִׁ֖ים אִמֶּ֑ךָ וַיְשַׁסֵּ֨ף שְׁמוּאֵ֧ל אֶת־אֲגָ֛ג לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה בַּגִּלְגָּֽל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And said Samuel, as made childless women your sword, so will be childless from women your mother. And hewed in pieces Samuel Agag before Yahweh in Gilgal.

en.L: And Samuel said, "As your sword has made women childless, so your mother shall be childless among women." And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Gilgal.
en.B: But Samuel said, "Just as your sword has robbed women of their children, so your mother will be robbed of her child among women." And Samuel cut Agag to pieces before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Gilgal.
en.R: But Samuel said, "Your sword has taken away the children of many mothers. Now your mother will lose her child too." Then Samuel cut Agag into pieces in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at Gilgal.

es.L: Y Samuel dijo: «Como tu espada ha dejado sin hijos a las mujeres, así quedará sin hijos tu madre entre las mujeres». Y Samuel despedazó a Agag delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Gilgal.
es.B: Pero Samuel le dijo: «Así como tu espada ha dejado a tantas mujeres sin sus hijos, así tu madre quedará sin su hijo entre las mujeres». Y Samuel hizo pedazos a Agag delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Gilgal.
es.R: Pero Samuel le dijo: «Tu espada les ha quitado los hijos a muchas madres. Ahora tu madre también perderá a su hijo». Entonces Samuel cortó a Agag en pedazos delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en Gilgal.

fr.L: Et Samuel dit : « Comme ton épée a privé des femmes de leurs enfants, ainsi ta mère sera privée d’enfant entre les femmes. » Et Samuel mit Agag en pièces devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Guilgal.
fr.B: Mais Samuel dit : « Comme ton épée a privé des femmes de leurs enfants, ainsi ta mère, parmi les femmes, sera privée de son enfant. » Et Samuel mit Agag en pièces devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} à Guilgal.
fr.R: Mais Samuel a dit : « Ton épée a enlevé leurs enfants à beaucoup de mères. Maintenant, ta mère va perdre son enfant elle aussi. » Puis Samuel a coupé Agag en morceaux devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, à Guilgal.

sw.L: Na Samweli akasema, "Kama upanga wako ulivyowafanya wanawake kuwa bila watoto, ndivyo mama yako atakavyokuwa bila mtoto kati ya wanawake." Na Samweli akamkatakata Agagi vipande vipande mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Gilgali.
sw.B: Lakini Samweli akasema, "Kama upanga wako ulivyowanyang'anya wanawake watoto wao, ndivyo mama yako atakavyonyang'anywa mtoto wake kati ya wanawake." Na Samweli akamkatakata Agagi vipande vipande mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Gilgali.
sw.R: Lakini Samweli akasema, "Upanga wako umewanyang'anya akina mama wengi watoto wao. Sasa mama yako naye atampoteza mtoto wake." Kisha Samweli akamkatakata Agagi vipande vipande mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} huko Gilgali.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên nói: "Gươm ngươi đã làm cho bao người đàn bà mất con thể nào, thì mẹ ngươi cũng sẽ mất con giữa vòng đàn bà thể ấy." Rồi Sa-mu-ên chặt A-ga ra từng mảnh trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Ghinh-ganh.
vi.B: Nhưng Sa-mu-ên nói: "Gươm ngươi đã cướp con của bao người đàn bà thể nào, thì mẹ ngươi cũng sẽ bị cướp mất con giữa vòng đàn bà thể ấy." Rồi Sa-mu-ên chặt A-ga ra từng mảnh trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Ghinh-ganh.
vi.R: Nhưng Sa-mu-ên nói: "Gươm ngươi đã cướp đi con cái của biết bao người mẹ. Bây giờ mẹ ngươi cũng sẽ mất con." Rồi Sa-mu-ên chặt A-ga ra từng mảnh trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Ghinh-ganh.

ko.L: 그러자 사무엘이 말했다. "네 칼이 여인들을 자식 없게 한 것처럼, 네 어미도 여인들 가운데서 자식 없는 자가 될 것이다." 그리고 사무엘이 길갈에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 아각을 찍어 쪼갰다.
ko.B: 그러나 사무엘이 말했다. "네 칼이 여인들에게서 자식을 빼앗았듯이, 네 어미도 여인들 가운데서 자식을 빼앗길 것이다." 그리고 사무엘은 길갈에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 아각을 칼로 쳐서 죽였다.
ko.R: 그러나 사무엘이 말했다. "네 칼이 수많은 어머니에게서 자식을 빼앗았다. 이제 네 어머니도 자식을 잃을 것이다." 그러고 나서 사무엘은 길갈에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 아각을 칼로 쳐 죽였다.

pt.L: E Samuel disse: "Como a sua espada deixou mulheres sem filhos, assim a sua mãe ficará sem filho entre as mulheres." E Samuel despedaçou Agague diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em Gilgal.
pt.B: Mas Samuel disse: "Assim como a sua espada tirou os filhos de muitas mulheres, assim a sua mãe ficará sem o seu filho entre as mulheres." E Samuel despedaçou Agague diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em Gilgal.
pt.R: Mas Samuel disse: "A sua espada tirou os filhos de muitas mães. Agora a sua mãe também vai perder o filho dela." Então Samuel cortou Agague em pedaços diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em Gilgal.

decisions.choice: as your sword has made women childless: Agag's death is a judgment on his own violence
decisions.reason: Samuel names Agag's own deeds as the ground of the sentence. What he did to others' children is done to him, and the command of verse 3 is carried out.

decisions.choice: hewed in pieces: put to death by the sword
decisions.reason: The verb occurs only here. It seems to mean cutting in pieces, a violent execution.

decisions.choice: before the LORD in Gilgal: at the sanctuary, as an act of judgment
decisions.reason: Gilgal was a place of worship (verses 12, 21). The execution is carried out in the LORD's presence as his sentence, not as private revenge.

decisions.choice: robbed women of their children (Balanced); taken away the children of many mothers (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out "made childless" and "childless among women". Readable adds "too", the link the verse implies.

source.text: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל הָרָמָ֑תָה וְשָׁא֛וּל עָלָ֥ה אֶל־בֵּית֖וֹ גִּבְעַ֥ת שָׁאֽוּל׃

records.literal_gloss: And went Samuel [to] Ramah, and Saul went up to his house [at] Gibeah of Saul.

en.L: And Samuel went to Ramah, and Saul went up to his house at Gibeah of Saul.
en.B: Then Samuel went to Ramah, and Saul went up to his home at Gibeah of Saul.
en.R: Then Samuel went to Ramah, and Saul went up to his home in Gibeah, the town where he lived.

es.L: Y Samuel se fue a Ramá, y Saúl subió a su casa en Guibeá de Saúl.
es.B: Luego Samuel se fue a Ramá, y Saúl subió a su casa en Guibeá de Saúl.
es.R: Luego Samuel se fue a Ramá, y Saúl subió a su casa en Guibeá, el pueblo donde vivía.

fr.L: Et Samuel s’en alla à Rama, et Saül monta à sa maison, à Guibea de Saül.
fr.B: Puis Samuel s’en alla à Rama, et Saül monta chez lui à Guibea de Saül.
fr.R: Ensuite, Samuel est parti à Rama, et Saül est monté chez lui, à Guibea, la ville où il habitait.

sw.L: Na Samweli akaenda Rama, na Sauli akapanda nyumbani kwake huko Gibea ya Sauli.
sw.B: Kisha Samweli akaenda Rama, na Sauli akapanda kwenda nyumbani kwake huko Gibea ya Sauli.
sw.R: Kisha Samweli akaenda Rama, na Sauli akapanda kwenda nyumbani kwake Gibea, mji alimoishi.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên đi về Ra-ma, còn Sau-lơ đi lên nhà mình tại Ghi-bê-a của Sau-lơ.
vi.B: Rồi Sa-mu-ên về Ra-ma, còn Sau-lơ lên nhà mình tại Ghi-bê-a của Sau-lơ.
vi.R: Rồi Sa-mu-ên về Ra-ma, còn Sau-lơ lên nhà mình ở Ghi-bê-a, là thành ông sống.

ko.L: 그리고 사무엘은 라마로 갔고, 사울은 사울의 기브아에 있는 자기 집으로 올라갔다.
ko.B: 그 뒤 사무엘은 라마로 갔고, 사울은 사울의 기브아에 있는 자기 집으로 올라갔다.
ko.R: 그 뒤 사무엘은 라마로 갔고, 사울은 자기가 사는 기브아의 집으로 올라갔다.

pt.L: E Samuel foi a Ramá, e Saul subiu à sua casa em Gibeá de Saul.
pt.B: Então Samuel foi para Ramá, e Saul subiu para a sua casa em Gibeá de Saul.
pt.R: Então Samuel foi para Ramá, e Saul subiu para a sua casa em Gibeá, a cidade onde ele morava.

decisions.choice: Ramah and Gibeah of Saul: each man's home
decisions.reason: Ramah was Samuel's home (7:17). Gibeah, in Benjamin, was Saul's home town and royal seat, and so it was called "Gibeah of Saul" (10:26; 11:4). The two men part and go their own ways.

decisions.choice: Gibeah, the town where he lived
decisions.reason: Readable explains "Gibeah of Saul" (m1).

source.text: וְלֹא־יָסַ֨ף שְׁמוּאֵ֜ל לִרְא֤וֹת אֶת־שָׁאוּל֙ עַד־י֣וֹם מוֹת֔וֹ כִּֽי־הִתְאַבֵּ֥ל שְׁמוּאֵ֖ל אֶל־שָׁא֑וּל וַיהוָ֣ה נִחָ֔ם כִּֽי־הִמְלִ֥יךְ אֶת־שָׁא֖וּל עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And not again Samuel to see Saul until [the] day of his death, for mourned Samuel for Saul; and Yahweh regretted that he had made king Saul over Israel.

en.L: And Samuel did not see Saul again until the day of his death, though Samuel mourned for Saul. And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} regretted that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had made Saul king over Israel.
en.B: Samuel did not go to see Saul again until the day he died, though Samuel grieved over Saul. And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} regretted having made Saul king over Israel.
en.R: Samuel did not go to see Saul again until the day he died. But Samuel was sad about Saul. And {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was sorry that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had made Saul king over Israel.

es.L: Y Samuel no volvió a ver a Saúl hasta el día de su muerte, aunque Samuel hacía duelo por Saúl. Y {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} le pesó haber hecho rey a Saúl sobre Israel.
es.B: Samuel no volvió a ver a Saúl hasta el día de su muerte, aunque lloraba por él. Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lamentó haber hecho a Saúl rey de Israel.
es.R: Samuel no fue a ver a Saúl nunca más hasta el día de su muerte. Pero Samuel estaba triste por Saúl. Y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} sintió haber hecho a Saúl rey de Israel.

fr.L: Et Samuel ne revit plus Saül jusqu’au jour de sa mort, mais Samuel prenait le deuil sur Saül. Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} regretta d’avoir fait régner Saül sur Israël.
fr.B: Samuel ne retourna plus voir Saül jusqu’au jour de sa mort, mais il le pleurait. Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} regretta d’avoir établi Saül comme roi d’Israël.
fr.R: Samuel n’est plus jamais allé voir Saül jusqu’au jour de sa mort. Mais Samuel était triste à cause de Saül. Et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} regrettait d’avoir fait de Saül le roi d’Israël.

sw.L: Na Samweli hakumwona Sauli tena mpaka siku ya kifo chake, ingawa Samweli alimwombolezea Sauli. Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akajuta kwamba alimfanya Sauli kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli.
sw.B: Samweli hakwenda kumwona Sauli tena mpaka siku alipokufa, ingawa Samweli alimhuzunikia Sauli. Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akajuta kwa kumfanya Sauli kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli.
sw.R: Samweli hakwenda kumwona Sauli tena mpaka siku alipokufa. Lakini Samweli alihuzunika kwa ajili ya Sauli. Na {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akasikitika kwamba alimfanya Sauli kuwa mfalme juu ya Israeli.

vi.L: Sa-mu-ên không gặp lại Sau-lơ cho đến ngày qua đời, dù Sa-mu-ên than khóc cho Sau-lơ. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hối tiếc vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập Sau-lơ làm vua trên Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Sa-mu-ên không đến gặp Sau-lơ nữa cho đến ngày qua đời, dù Sa-mu-ên vẫn đau buồn vì Sau-lơ. Còn {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thì hối tiếc vì đã lập Sau-lơ làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Sa-mu-ên không đến gặp Sau-lơ nữa cho đến ngày qua đời. Nhưng Sa-mu-ên buồn rầu về Sau-lơ. Còn {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thì buồn lòng vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập Sau-lơ làm vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 사무엘은 죽는 날까지 다시는 사울을 보지 않았다. 그러나 사무엘은 사울을 위해 슬퍼했다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 사울을 이스라엘 위에 왕으로 세우신 것을 후회하셨다.
ko.B: 사무엘은 죽는 날까지 다시는 사울을 만나러 가지 않았다. 그러면서도 사무엘은 사울 때문에 슬퍼했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 사울을 이스라엘의 왕으로 세우신 것을 후회하셨다.
ko.R: 사무엘은 죽는 날까지 다시는 사울을 만나러 가지 않았다. 그러나 사무엘은 사울 때문에 마음이 아팠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 사울을 이스라엘의 왕으로 세우신 것을 마음 아파하셨다.

pt.L: E Samuel não tornou a ver Saul até o dia da sua morte, embora Samuel chorasse por Saul. E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} se arrependeu de ter feito Saul rei sobre Israel.
pt.B: Samuel não foi mais ver Saul até o dia da sua morte, embora Samuel sentisse grande tristeza por Saul. E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lamentou ter feito Saul rei sobre Israel.
pt.R: Samuel não foi mais ver Saul até o dia em que morreu. Mas Samuel ficou triste por causa de Saul. E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} ficou triste por ter feito Saul rei sobre Israel.

decisions.choice: did not see again: did not come to see Saul
alternatives: until the day of Saul's death
decisions.reason: Saul later comes to where Samuel is (19:22-24), but Samuel never again goes to Saul as his prophet. "His death" is most likely Samuel's own; Samuel died before Saul (25:1), and Saul then sought him through a medium (28:11-19).

decisions.choice: though: Samuel grieved even as he stayed away
decisions.reason: The linking word can mean "for" or "but". Read as "for", Samuel stayed away because he was mourning Saul as one already lost. Read as "though", he kept away and yet grieved. Both show a real sorrow over Saul.

decisions.choice: the LORD regretted: as in verse 11
decisions.reason: The chapter closes with the word it began with (verse 11; see the note there and at verse 29). God's grief over Saul and the end of his favor to Saul's reign stand together with his refusal to take back the sentence.

decisions.choice: regretted (Literal, Balanced); was sorry (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 11.
